Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Q, Joe, Murr and Sal find scandalous diary entries written by their daughters, then break up with significant others in front of baffled strangers. The loser finds himself in hot water and on shaky ground while waiting tables.

The guys pitch their whimsical TV show ideas to focus groups. They go to the park with their daughters who share unpopular opinions with strangers, and the loser heads to the spa for an electrifying punishment two years in the making.
After Debra's mother suggests throwing Debra an old-fashioned English tea party, Ray reluctantly agrees after she promises to do all the work.

Robert and Amy convince their families to spend Thanksgiving together. The day livens up when the families split into teams of Native Americans and Pilgrims to recreate the original Thanksgiving party.
When the children ruin Ray's dictionary, Frank tells them about the time Ray wrecked his prized jazz record collection.
When Debra accepts a position at Frank's lodge to help plan a member recruitment party, Ray begins to resent how much time she is spending away from home.
When Raymond lies and tells Debra that he's already bought her an incredibly thoughtful Christmas present, he frantically tries to figure out what to get her.
Frank must make amends with his granddaughter, Ally, when she catches him stealing food at the supermarket.
Charlie and Laura crash a party attended by Michael Caine.
Charlie rents Caroline's cottage to an aspiring actress.
Caroline trains Charlie for a PTA boxing match.
A work-study programme puts Joanna in Caroline's employ.
Sabrina is torn between attending Harvey's big game and helping Josh study for his big exam. Meanwhile, Hilda and Zelda hire a band of pirates to clean house.
Sabrina zaps on a skin cream to appear more mature after college-guy Josh shoots down a romance because of her age, but the fast-acting lotion ends up being a rapid-aging potion.
Consumed with guilt over kissing Josh, Sabrina tries to get Harvey to forgive her without having to say she is sorry.
Sabrina and Harvey's plans for a romantic ski weekend are thwarted when they are trapped in a snowstorm with Brad.
Sabrina organises a date for Salem's high-school reunion - Juliette, a totally selfish but beautiful cat.
During the Christmas holidays, Sabrina magically erases winter so she can enjoy a Jamaican holiday, but an angry mother nature turns her into a snowman.

Desperate for her and Harvey to win the cutest couple at the Winter Ball, Sabrina becomes obsessed with her body image and goes on a crash diet. However, it goes wrong when she loses too much weight and disappears.
Sabrina's sloppy spell casting turns Harvey into his childhood superhero idol, while Kraft quits school to become a world-famous aviator.
Sabrina receives a Valentine's card from a secret admirer, but she must find out who the mystery man is before he steals her heart forever.
Duke, an old crony of Salem's and former con man, has finished his sentence as a cat and is ready to go straight, but his commitment soon starts to waver.
Salem is heartbroken to receive a wedding announcement from his estranged daughter Annabelle, who hasn't spoken to him in decades.
Dreama is accidentally turned into a mouse when she catches Sabrina's (Melissa Joan Hart) spring fever.
Sabrina resents having to live by all her aunt rules, but when she suddenly becomes the rule enforcer, she starts to see things differently.
Sabrina's bratty cousin pays a visit and though appearing sweeter and more grown-up, she has an ulterior motive - to steal Harvey from Sabrina. Watch out Sabrina.
Sabrina's indecisiveness over which college place to accept causes her to be torn apart, literally, into four different Sabrinas.
Josh and Harvey are fighting for Sabrina's affection, so she feeds them magic friendship bread to bring peace, but they become too close and start to ignore her.
After spending the summer trying to get over her first love, Sabrina decides to make some big changes in her life.
In order to keep up with the overwhelming academic and social demands of college life, Sabrina puts herself under a complicated time spell to move at lightning speed.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) throws a Halloween bash that turns into the year's biggest party. Guests star: Tisha Campbell.
When Sabrina realises she has been turning down guys right and left since her break-up, she casts a spell to turn herself into a dating machine.

Feeling guilty for denying Chandler a bachelor party, Monica hires a stripper to perform for him, without learning that she's a prostitute. Elsewhere, Rachel's father learns about her pregnancy and plans to give Ross a piece of his mind.

An old high-school friend of Monica's is invited to the Thanksgiving dinner with the gang, but Monica is unaware that he isn't exactly fond of Rachel. Meanwhile, Chandler and Phoebe pretend to be mesmerised by American football in order to avoid helping Monica in the kitchen, and Joey vows to devour the entire turkey single-handedly.
Chandler is aghast when Monica buys painfully expensive boots, and Phoebe tries to capitalise on her discovery that Ross's son attends school with the son of rock star Sting.
Ross's new girlfriend wants to put their photograph on Christmas cards, Rachel eyes Joey as a possible romantic partner, and the newlyweds cope with Chandler's boss as he goes through a divorce.

As Joey agonises over his secret affection for Rachel, Monica mistakenly thinks that he is infatuated with Phoebe. Meanwhile, Ross and Rachel promise not to try to find out the sex of their unborn child, but Rachel can't resist having a peek inside the doctor's confidential folder. Also, Monica urges a reluctant Chandler to enjoy the soothing pleasures of a scented bath, but realises that she's created a tub monster.

Joey rushes pregnant Rachel to hospital when she experiences pains. When Ross feels left out, Joey makes a gallant suggestion. Meanwhile, Chandler is surprised to discover what is behind the locked door of Monica's secret cupboard, and Phoebe gets the impression that Monica is enjoying one of her massages a little too much.
Jimmy, GK Barry and Jamali are passing judgement on some potential wrongdoers. Taking the stand tonight is a romantic gesture fail, and someone who refuses to date if the stars don't align.

Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Jack Dee, Claudia Winkleman, David O'Doherty and Josh Widdicombe as they thrash out the hot topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Richard Bacon, Gemma Collins, Katherine Ryan and Henning Wehn as they thrash out the hot topics of the week.

Survival expert and international star Bear Grylls bravely hands over his phone in Send To All. Pop sensation Liam Payne performs his latest hit single, 'Stack It Up', and there is an incredible performance from the Unexpected Star Of The Show.
The Reno Sheriff's Department brings in a Hollywood acting coach to teach them how to act more like criminals and meth-heads.
Sketches include an introduction to the newest set of East/West Bowl players; Devon the Landlord searches Jordan's flat; Jordan is offended by an overly sexual co-worker.
Host Michael Kosta interviews actor and producer Gemma Chan, promoting the film "Josephine".

Mr Bean buys a portable television but can't get it to work properly. Then, when his camera is stolen, he must identify the suspect in a police line-up. Afterwards, he attends a magic show and disco with his girlfriend but ends up embarrassing her.
Mr Bean rushes to the dentist's office after oversleeping, then helps a boy fix his remote-controlled toy boat, and later is menaced by a wasp while having a picnic.

Joey accidentally informs a cast member that she will be fired so that his character will get her character's brain, and Ross plans a surprise for Monica and Chandler's wedding - he wants to play the bagpipes.
Monica and Chandler fondly reminisce about London until a startling revelation leaves Chandler floored. Meanwhile, Rachel teaches Ben practical jokes to play on Ross.

Monica regrets telling a fellow bride-to-be about a cheaper bridal shop, and later she has to fight the woman tooth and nail for a unique wedding dress before competing with her to hire Chandler's favourite band for the night. Meanwhile, Joey and Ross discover that they're dating the same girl.

Joey is overjoyed to be nominated for a 'Soapie', the third most prestigious award in daytime dramas. Meanwhile, engaged Monica frets when she realises she will never experience the thrill of a new relationship again, Ross spots Chandler sneaking out of a male strip club, and Phoebe meets a cute guy.

Rachel bumps into a girl she knew in college, and Monica tells everyone they made out once when they were drunk. While making their seating plans for the wedding, Chandler is sad that only 10 percent of the guests are his.
With only four weeks until their wedding, Monica and Chandler try to write their vows. Chandler enlists the boys' help, while Monica does the same with the girls.

Monica convinces a reluctant Chandler to travel to Las Vegas to invite his estranged cross-dressing father to their wedding. Meanwhile, Rachel is furious that she is the only friend who Monica has not allowed to drive the Porsche that her father gave her.
Monica and Chandler prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, Joey is starring in a movie with a prestigious actor with a spitting problem.
Joey encounters problems trying to get off the movie set to officiate the wedding when the star turns up drunk.

Monica and Chandler's wedding reception is almost upstaged by the news that someone might be pregnant. Meanwhile, Ross tries to impress a pretty single woman, Chandler has troubles on the dance floor, and Joey hopes to impress Chandler's mum's date, an important Broadway producer, with his acting ability.
The girls speculate as to who's the father of Rachel's baby, the guys scramble after Chandler loses the film from his wedding, and Monica wants to open the wedding gifts.
Everybody seems to know who the father of Rachel's baby is except the man himself. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Joey lie about a gas leak to get into Monica and Chandler's apartment.
Ross gets upset when Rachel goes out on a date with a handsome actor, Phoebe tries to prevent a chef from being sacked, and Chandler kills a co-worker's promotion.
At Monica's Halloween party, Phoebe meets the friendly fiancé of her flighty twin Ursula, but becomes alarmed when she learns that her sister has misrepresented herself to her trusting future in-law.
Mr Bean has a grand day at the hairdresser's, enters Teddy in a pet show and has to find his way off a train when he loses his ticket.

Mr Bean goes to a swimming pool but finds himself terrified of the high diving board, afterwards, he must try several imaginative ways to get out of the car park when he doesn't have enough money to pay. He then demonstrates the proper way to make a sandwich whilst out at the park. Finally, when Mr Bean and his girlfriend go on a date to watch a horror movie he teases her for being scared until the film actually starts.

Detective Riggs and Murtaugh are called into action to foil a Chinese crime lord who is selling immigrants into slavery on American soil. The pair aren't as young as they used to be, and ending up on a Triad hit list doesn't make things easy for them either.
Aisha Tyler hosts another memorable episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Gary Anthony Williams.
Vinnie Politan takes a deep dive into the true-crime stories that are captivating the world over, featuring sharp analysis and insightful interviews for a deeper understanding of these cases.

Jurors learned about the lavish lifestyle of the Farris family. On the stand, Scott Farris, the youngest son of Gary and Melody, recalled how Melody liked to shop and had full access to the family account until months before the murder.
On the stand, Scott Farris explained to the jury how his father, Gary, operated and managed the burn pile on the family farm. It was there that his charred remains were found.
It was the second day of the defendant's youngest son testifying against her. Scott Farris broke down details of those weeks leading up to his father, Gary's, shooting death.
Jurors listened to more descriptive testimony from the person who discovered Gary Farris' human remains.

Former Miss Georgia contestant Tara Grinstead vanished without a trace in 2005. Vinnie Politan investigates if Ryan Duke, the man arrested for her murder over a decade later, was really the mastermind.

Kyle Rittenhouse shot and killed two people and maimed a third during a Black Lives Matter protest in Kenosha, Wisconsin. The 17-year-old, armed with an AR-15, claimed he acted in self-defence because he feared for his life.

A clown carrying balloons and a basket of flowers shot and killed Marlene Warren when she opened her front door in 1990. Even though police suspected Warren's ex-husband and his then-girlfriend, it would take decades to make an arrest.
During a quiet summer evening in 2017, a woman dials 911 to report her husband is dead on the floor of his snake breeding facility.
Live gavel-to-gavel coverage, in-depth legal reporting and expert analysis of America's most important and compelling trials.
It's a wild Alaska summer day as troopers locate a naked wolf hunter, track a suspected felon through the woods and respond to an animal hoarder in a remote village just north of the Arctic Circle.

On July 14, 2013, Kelvin Newton strangled his wife Assia to death. Daughters Sameera and Charmaine reveal how losing their mother shattered the family, while David and Emma look into the devastating effects of domestic homicide.

The abduction and murder of a pregnant woman and her fiancé from their Decatur home sends shockwaves throughout Atlanta; ransom calls and voicemails turn into digital breadcrumbs for investigators to track the killers down.
A teenager waiting for her friends to give her a ride home from work suddenly disappears. When her friends arrive, they find terrifying evidence of her abduction.

On the edge of divorce, a couple's argument over custody turns deadly. The husband claims he killed his wife in self-defence when she attacked him with scissors, but a look into his past holds a deadly secret.
Two unusual accidents that are two decades apart leave a family suspicious of a father who appears to benefit from tragedy.
Just days after Hollie Gazzard had attempted to end her relationship with Asher Maslin, her life was cut tragically short as the jealous ex attacked.
A 12-year-old paperboy's disappearance during his Sunday morning route shocks a peaceful Iowa city. Panic sets in when a second paperboy goes missing.

A young boy and his family's housekeeper are brutally murdered in an upscale Omaha neighbourhood. Their case remains unsolved for years until another double homicide reveals a link and unmasks a serial killer.
A beloved University of Kentucky football player is murdered on his doorstep during his 21st birthday party in an assassination-style killing.
When homesick university student Miya Marcano books a flight to South Florida for the weekend, her family is thrilled. However, when the plane lands, Miya is nowhere to be found.
Weeks after a pregnant woman is shot and killed in Orlando, a shootout between her suspected killer and a police officer sparks a manhunt.

Two cold cases, the 1992 murder of school teacher Christy Mirack in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, and the 1990 murder of Genevieve Zitricki in Greenville, South Carolina, were finally solved thanks to advancements in DNA technology.
A murderer and judge square off; a distraught defendant who can't face his sentence does the unthinkable; a bailiff gets caught trying to go above the law.

A convicted cop killer goes on an f-bomb tirade in court; a defendant reveals his fandom for the judge before that same judge admonishes him for bad behaviour in virtual court; the family of a murder victim lashes out at the killer - a family friend.

The courtroom erupts into chaos during a hearing for a murder case; the judge chastises a defendant for making horrible decisions; a prosecutor strongly disagrees with what he feels is an unreasonable sentence from the judge.
Two teenage former best friends face off in court. A cold-blooded murderer addresses the family of his victim. A judge says the wrong thing at the wrong time to the wrong person.

A man convicted of murdering his five-year-old son makes a scene in the courtroom; a convicted killer won't stay in his seat during his virtual sentencing; a man in court for allegedly violating his parole is held without bond.

The judge loses his patience with a man accused of drunk boating; a defendant waiting outside the courtroom is physically assaulted; a woman being sued for back rent screams at the judge during her virtual hearing; and more.

A woman accused of driving with a suspended licence yells expletives at the judge; a grieving mother screams at her daughter's killer; a judge gets tough while sentencing a young father for aggravated robbery; and more.

A man ordered into custody attempts a daring escape from court and a judge doesn't appreciate a defendant's constant interruptions. A woman faces off against her mother, who tried to frame her for murder.

A man accused of murder, tries to attend his arraignment naked; a woman accused of assaulting her mother, hangs up on her virtual hearing; a man seeking a protection order against his wife gives a judge the finger in court.
A defendant has multiple outbursts at trial. A man about to be sentenced attempts a courtroom escape. A judge is frustrated by a defendant's constant disruptions.

A man whose bond has just been raised to $20,000 attempts an escape from the courthouse; a defendant about to be sentenced for drink-driving reports to court, drunk; a man checks in for his virtual plea hearing from an aeroplane; and more.

The mother of a man on trial for murder gets caught for taking a picture of the jury; a defendant is held in contempt of court after flipping off the judge, twice; a judge chastises a disgraced estate attorney and more.

A grieving man jumps over the gallery railing and goes after his brother's killer; a defendant gets his bond revoked after angering the judge; a man tries to blame spiked cake frosting for his failed blood alcohol test.

A grieving mother confronts the family of her son's killer. A woman is sentenced for eating doughnuts without paying for them. A convicted murderer is verbally confronted in court by his victim's family, and more.

A defendant kicks over a jailhouse camera while throwing a temper tantrum during his bond hearing; a serial abductor hears from the mother of his latest victim in court; a man accused of domestic violence is caught breaking his bond conditions.
A man leads police on a high-speed chase in a stolen mail truck; a restaurant owner is arrested after hiding drugs in a takeout box; a pizza delivery guy helps the cops arrest a thief.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a topless woman leads authorities on a high-speed pursuit, and a man escapes through a drive-through window with the store's cash register.
A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A naked man allegedly attacks police with a shovel, and a woman refuses to leave a restaurant until she gets a free glass of water.

A love triangle at the University of Florida results in the murder of a popular student. An undeniable digital trail leads straight to his murderer and helps authorities piece together the details of the crime and secure a conviction.

When a 19-year-old struggling to make it on her own goes missing, her family kicks into high gear to find her. As precious time runs out and the hope of bringing her home alive grows dim, two unlikely people team up to confront a dangerous predator.
In Tulsa, two men are murdered in a car park, but a gun from another shooting incident leads detectives to their suspect.
Reality, Documentary, Crime, Comedy drama, Drama, Historical drama
Aidan Chapman is struck during a Christmas Eve vehicle attack in London's crowded West End.

A Neo-Nazi turned Islamic jihadist shoots two of his roommates after an argument. In a combative interview with journalist David Scott, Devon Arthurs, now claiming to be remorseful, attempts to explain his descent into madness.
For decades, Terry Peder Rasmussen moved across America under different identities. Investigators unravel the story of the man dubbed the Chameleon Killer.

When a predator plans to meet a 13-year-old at the mall, Detective Tony Godwin races to pull off his fastest ever takedown. Then, an FBI lead points to one home and two suspects. And a predator's deviant secret is discovered in a church dumpster.
Joseph Z provides prophetic commentary on global events through faith-based journalism and teaching.
Join Pastors Larry and Tiz Huch from Dallas, Texas as they share revelations from the Word of God.
Renowned Christian scholar Rick Renner delves into the Greek New Testament, blending historical texts with modern illustrations to unpack God's message for His believers.
Pastor Shawn Baker challenges any and all to get closer to God and to learn how to embrace the life that He has prepared for every single person.
Bible teaching with an emphasis on prophecy, Israel and the Jewish roots of Christianity.
Stories of life, love, and hope from the mission fields of Haiti.
A religious programme fronted by Reverend Samuel Rodriguez.
The worldwide ministry of Rod Parsley and his work to revive the life of God in human hearts.
Joni and guests tackle a wide range of relevant issues, controversial subjects and hard-hitting news topics with candour and wit.
Col Tim Moore, director of Lamb and Lion Ministries, looks to national and international events.
Messianic rabbi KA Schneider looks at how the Old and New Testaments are integrated, building faith and changing lives.
Rabbi Jonathan Bernis of Jewish Voice Ministries shares the lessons he learned after his miraculous health recovery.
Kenneth Copeland Ministries is a teaching ministry assigned by God to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ all around the world and without compromise in order to get the message out that Jesus is Lord.
Equipping Pastors, group leaders and church members with biblical truth and tools to heal themselves and take healing to a wounded world.
Familiar hymns and beautifully produced original music accompany Scripture to help you let go and surrender during a time of daily prayer and meditation.
Host Nancy Dufresne shares messages addressing the topics of faith, healing, renewing the mind, following the Holy Spirit and a life in Christ.
A church service including praise and worship and an inspiring message by Pastor Mac Hammond.
Missionaries Tim Scott and Will Decker find themselves in a dangerous situation when their drivers attempt to kidnap and possibly kill them.
A longtime foster child attends a church-based support group whose leader uses the Ten Commandments as the basis of his teachings.

Chris Quantum is a typical middle school student, but one of his best friends is a robot named Gizmo and the other is Joy Pepper. The adventures begin for this trio when a mysterious device appears and takes them on journeys throughout the Bible.

Pastor Doug and the gang explore how God sees people. God doesn't look at someone's outward appearance, He sees through to who they really are: the condition of their heart. A look at this truth in the story of David and Goliath.

Doug welcomes a lost puppy into his new home, but young Dusty still has some learning to do. After a major mess-up in the garden, Dusty worries Doug won't love him any more and considers running away.
Cowboy Dan teaches children some valuable life lessons.
This animated Gospel-centred series follows a group of student owls as they adventure along creatively learning about nature, faith, and God.
Chris is hooked on becoming the most powerful 'god' in the online 3D game, 'Battleverse of the Gods'! Suddenly, Superbook sends them to a time when Elijah battles the prophets of Baal.
Heroes and heroines of Christian faith, both Biblical and contemporary.
The Scaly Adventures Crew journeys the world in search of amazing animals and incredible adventures.
Author, speaker, and mentor, Drenda Keesee wants you and your family to find happiness, live spiritually whole and prosper emotionally.

Chris Mitchell reports from one of the most explosive regions in the world. Offers a biblical and prophetic perspective to the daily news events that shape our world, with a particular focus on Israel and the Middle East.
Israel Now News is a weekly TV news magazine. It presents a unique perspective of Israel's current events, politics, and culture to an English-speaking audience.
David and his team including Corrie Jeffrey, James Layte, David Hakeney and Debbie Serpell are in Oldham today where a fascinating medal turns up on James's table.

David and his dealers are in Winsford where Helen Gardiner discovers that clinching a deal for two rare German toys is far from child's play and Henry Nicholls gets a blast from the past from a retro phone.

David and the team are in Blackburn where they come face to face with a tiger, other items of interest include a Doulton facemask which Corrie Jeffrey worries she has been charmed by, and Mark Stevens meets his match when he haggles with a father and son over a gentleman's wristwatch.

David and his dealers Michael Hogben, Mark Stevens, Stewart Hofgartner and Corrie Jeffrey are in Blackburn. Items of interest include a Victorian wax seal, a Clarice Cliff jug and an obscure telephone repair kit.
Skipton is the location today as Cheryl Hakeney gets herself in a spin over an Art Deco bronze figure, other items brought along include a Royal Doulton Toby jug, and a cavalier sword.
Burton-on-Trent is the location today as a naive marine painting comes through the door, and there are some saucy postcards that make Jo Brayshaw chuckle.
When the security guards start spooking customers, the Les sends them home to teach them a lesson. Yet when some angry customers make outrageous demands, and the Golds have to fend for themselves.
An argument with Seth leaves Ashley in tears and Karen attempts to broker a peace deal, Bobby J takes a joyride on two-story tractor, and a watch snob finds himself on Seth's bad side.

A ventriloquist leaves Karen and Bobby J speechless, an angry 🥊 [MMA] MMA fighter takes a swing at Byron, and an odd couple delivers a huge surprise when they try to sell the Golds' art they claim is worth over a million dollars.

David Dickinson and antique dealers Brenda Haller, Henry Nicholls, Janice Kehoe and David Ford are in Leek in Staffordshire, where items of interest include glass sailing boats, a Rolex watch, a Chinese snuff bottle and some valuable Corgi toy cars.

Leek in Staffordshire plays host to David Dickinson and his team of antique dealers today, David Ford has a hoot with a seller who brought in a Minton vase and Janice Kehoe remembers the days of the Flappers with a 1920s beaded bag, while one seller nets a large sum for his steam train painting.

David is in Leek, with dealers Henry Nicholls, Janice Kehoe, Brenda Haller and David Ford. Amongst the items brought in are a map that belonged to a French general in the Crimean war, and a striking Bernard Moore vase.

David Dickinson and his antiques dealers David Ford, Brenda Haller, Janice Kehoe and Henry Nicholls travel to Leek in Staffordshire where diamonds are forever and a seven stone diamond ring causes a stir in the room.

David and the team are in Ilford for a "Text Santa" edition of the show. The dealers are Michael Hogben, Cheryl Hakeney and Jan Keyne as well as some special guests - a whole family of pearly kings and queens.
David and his team attempt to sort the treasures from the rubbish in Skipton today. Jo Brayshaw gets a lesson on haggling from a lady keen to raise cash for her son's birthday.
David and his team are in St Albans where Simon Schneider learns about Mughal bling, Ian Towning has a date with 'The Green Lady' and Karen Dalmeny gets to the bottom of an obscure Victorian stick.

David is joined by dealers Cheryl Hakeney, Henry Nicholls, Jan Keyne and Mark Stevens as they visit Congleton. Items of interest include a Lalique perfume bottle, a concertina and a gentleman's blotter.

While exploring the historic silver mining town of Cobalt, the salvage team uncovers some exciting hidden treasures inside an old Nash car dealership, including a massive 1915 Woolworth's sign and vintage jukeboxes.
Under the watchful eye of Uncle Ryan, Julien puts his operator skills to the test during a delicate and risky demolition job.
Vic goes on a road trip to salvage a pair of vintage gas pumps to add to his personal collection.
As the Priestlys look to the future, Ted's salvage team is tasked with clearing out The National with a huge one-day sale.
Ted and Justin travel to Market Village Mall in Markham, Ontario, where they are tasked with carefully unlocking mysterious vault doors while the demolition team begins tear down.

At the site of the former Yugoslavian Consulate, Ted hopes to salvage invaluable secret relics of the Cold War. Back at the National, a buyer shows interest in a vintage WW II truck, but Ted has to convince him the price is right.
Les shakes hands on the single biggest purchase in the entire history of the store, but a shocking phone call reveals the art dealers may be fraudsters and the mega-deal is in jeopardy.

Les Gold introduces viewers to the world of American Jewellery and Loan, a pawn shop in 8 Mile Detroit. Les and his son Seth try to manage irate customers and deal with head of security, Robo, biting a fellow employee.

Les's daughter Ashley strikes a deal to return to the family business, but it is not all smooth sailing. The shop sees some bizarre requests as a customer tries to pawn her teeth and another wants to sell his prize head.

An angry customer threatens Les and puts the store on high alert. Amidst the chaos, Ashley and Seth have a friendly wager on whether a stripper pole will sell. When the angry customer returns, security lets them get away and Les unleashes his rage.
The Golds clash over the need to arm everyone in the store after a customer threatens Les. Then, the competition heats up between Ashley and Seth over the pawn of an alcoholic beverage machine.

When an alligator turns on its owner, he tries to sell it to the Golds but Ashley and Seth want no part of the reptile. A man wants to pawn his bulletproof vest, so Les tells him he needs to take him outside and test it.
Contestants travel to South Africa to try to win the top prize; viewers get the chance to help select the next "Deal or No Deal" model.
