Live feed from Mecca every day that would enlighten our viewers by bringing visuals live from Islam's Holiest.
Melodious recitation of the Holy Qur'an with English translation.
Lesley Hazleton discusses humanity and where might be going wrong.
Condemnation without understanding leads to tunnel vision and incorrect judgement.
Revealing the world of extreme chemistry.

Offering valuable education on the teachings of Islam presented in an entertaining and stimulating way. Br Muhammad and Little Maryam help the little explorers as they join in the fun and adventure of learning.
Your Topics, My Response is part of a lecture series entitled Reclaiming Our Faith. This lecture is delivered by Hamza Yusuf.
A look at some of the shinning stars of Islam.
Examines the companions of the Holy Prophet, their exemplary life, and example.
Lecture titled 'Good and Evil, is it all from Allah?' delivered by Faraz Khan.
The history and compilation of the Qur'an.
A lecture series by Ml. Farouk Soofie. The focus is manners and behaviour acceptable to societal Norms.
Documentary on Neanderthals, an extinct species of humans. The documentary looks into the scientific study of these beings of the past.
Ntokozo Hlongwane talks to an inspired audience in Durban, City Hall about How To Pass Matric With Maximum Distinctions, his highly influential book which has sent matric pass rates through the roof.
A palaeontology documentary on Dinosaurs. The focus is on Spinosaurus aegyptiacus.
Lecture on the control of one's inhibitions and becoming an internal activist in the quest for spiritual attainment.
Lecture on the importance of managing one's time.
The captains find a rare strain of red king crab in the north amid crushing ice and violent storms. Sig deploys an underwater drone to pinpoint the horde.
Rewriting history, Josh helps discover a tomb at Petra's iconic Treasury. The twelve skeletons inside may belong to a royal family of Petra.

Josh Gates hunts for the truth behind the world's most iconic and fascinating legends. Leaving no stone unturned, Josh's adventures take him around the globe and into dangerous situations as he dives in to uncover the truth behind enduring mysteries.
A young couple's dream adobe homestead in New Mexico is dying, smothered by invasive trees; the Raneys take on their first adobe home rescue.
Captains Sig & Sophia locate a hybrid crab, hitting the jackpot — but filling their tanks creates an imbalance, putting the Northwestern on the brink of capsize.
How do they build a tractor every three minutes to power Indian agriculture? How do they cast the bronze bells that help Swiss farmers keep track of their cows?
How do they collect millions of real birds' nests to make birds' nest soup? How do they use aerospace technology to make rowers go faster? And, how are castanets made?
Many items that make up the modern world are the result of sophisticated engineering and production processes. How do they do it?
Looking at how they harness the wind to power a racing yacht to Olympic gold. Plus, how they make a sword fit for an officer at the world's largest sword factory.

Dr. Jeff preps a Shiba Inu for surgery after she's struck by a car, but test results reveal a grim reality. Dr. Baier performs his first-ever wild goose operation, and an obese Yorkshire Terrier struggling to walk begins a strict weight-loss plan.

There's no such thing as a regular day at Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic. Dr. Jeff Young and his team represent one last hope and possibly the difference between life and death for beloved pets and wild animals.
The duo build a giant centre bar aquarium for the owners of Wind Creek Casino. This tank marks ATM's 10,000th tank and is one of the largest they've ever built.
The Dieselsellerz SEMA build hits a snag, and the guys rush to find a replacement. They decide to rebuild and give away their most iconic build, The Megaram.
A new client asks for the biggest build and challenge yet: a monster school bus capable of driving over sand and water. The Muscle brings in a build for a gym buddy — a Raptor-style F250.

The crew race to finish the monster school bus with a 40-foot drive train and 66-inch tyres that is one of their biggest builds yet. Meanwhile, Redbeard discovers the Mello Yello race car from Days of Thunder.
Major league pitcher Jacob deGrom asks the crew to revamp his OBS Ford. Also, they convert a rare British Land Rover Defender from right-hand to left-hand drive for a client.
The guys convert a rare Land Rover Defender from right-hand drive to left. Furthermore, in an attempt to get money for the shop, Heavy D parts out a military plane de-icer.
The crew overhaul a truck for a local dad who was harassed at a local campsite when his F350 broke down. Also, they assemble the shop's first-ever diesel motorcycle, with a Magneto.
Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut. Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing. Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black pay dirt.

A couple buys a dilapidated cabin in Phillips, Maine, in hopes of keeping the area's fly-fishing traditions alive. Chase Morrill and his team pull out all the stops to fix a myriad of issues in just 11 weeks.

A family of eight sets out to build an underground home in the rolling foothills of Idaho, but Mother Nature has other plans for them; before they even pour concrete, they face a decision that will make or break their build.

In an abandoned African wasteland, 12 battle-tested veterans scavenge ruins to survive. Camps turn old tires into shoes and use barbed wire as protection from aggressive lions. A rogue elephant forces Steven's camp to make shelter from junked cars.

As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.
The mysterious bacteria that imperilled the NASA space program; the decrepit remains of a mythical beast; a hidden bug that painted the world in a whole new colour.
The hidden truth behind the murder of a wealthy oil heir; an ominous orb in Michigan's night sky; a pesky plant that turns into a cash crop for a Kansas woman.
Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres dive into the legend of Mothman by searching for clues in a long-sealed bunker and a top-secret Air Force base.

Josh ventures to Argentina, where many Nazi SS officers escaped to after World War II. He uncovers secret Nazi hideouts and investigates what may be the most shocking conspiracy about Adolf Hitler's ultimate fate.
Henry and Fuzz head to Lincolnshire to see Kevin's collection of vintage lorries and trucks. They find a Cornish fire engine.
Henry and Fuzz are staying local, visiting Francis' farm in Oxfordshire. There are tractors, bikes and trinkets.
Henry and Fuzz are down in Somerset visiting Mike's farm. They could play it safe with a motorbike or take a risk on something agricultural.
The pursuit of profit sees Henry and Fuzz rummaging through Rebecca and Sue's sheds near Newark. It's home to all manner of vehicles and parts.
Bruce goes to a Cold War underground bunker that has been converted to a museum. The curator is looking for some Soviet era equipment to tell the other side of the story.
Bruce hears about some second world war British airborne division gear from the battle of Arnhem for sale, which is of big interest to ex-paratroopers like him and Freddie.
Bruce Crompton marks the 75th Anniversary of VE Day, sending rare German half-track vehicles to partake in a battle re-enactment. In France, he seeks VE Day relics.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the New Forest, looking for things to buy, restore and sell for profit. Today they meet Stumpie, an Americana fanatic whose sheds are full of rare bicycles, classic sportsters and pimped up saloon cars.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in Cornwall, looking for things to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. Today they visit the Queen's armourer, Terry English, and find an amazing collection of vintage British cars, bikes and engines.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the West Country searching for things to buy, restore and sell for a profit. Today they discover sheds full of classic bikes, vintage cars and extraordinary limousines, including one owned by Eva Perón.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in East Sussex looking for things to buy, restore and sell for a profit. Today they visit a collector of American Iron, who has an array of quirky vehicles including hot rods, trucks and miniature bikes.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the Midlands looking for things to buy, restore and sell for a profit. Today they visit bike builder Patrick Walker. He shows them some fantastic rare bikes, but what does he keep in his freezer?

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in Sam's home territory, Cornwall, looking for things to buy, restore and sell for a profit. Today they meet a trials car enthusiast with the most eclectic set of sheds they've encountered so far.
French polisher Alex tries to piece a grand Tudor style four-poster bed back together. Drew asks sculptor Nick to rescue a pair of decorative corbels and breathe some new life into them.
Arcade game expert Dr Pinball restores a rare 1940s American basketball game to its former glory. Artist Nick gets creative when he replasters and repaints a vintage life-size model bull.
Upholsterer, Craig, makes an attempt to save a pair of sofas used in the Dr Who TV series. Plus, blacksmith, Nev, turns a pair of street lamps into statement lights suitable for a home.

New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

A brand-new NASA mission to the Sun reveals cutting-edge discoveries about Earth's star; as the Parker Solar Probe dives through the Sun's atmosphere, what it finds challenges everything we know about this strange place.

An explosion in the discovery of exoplanets is challenging everything we know about our universe; experts use cutting-edge astronomy to investigate these mysterious alien worlds and how they defy the laws of physics.

A deadly design flaw results in a horrifying rush hour bridge collapse that tragically leaves 13 dead in Minneapolis. Using the latest science, experts investigate to reveal what went wrong on one of Minnesota's busiest crossings.

A Corvette disappears into a hole in the ground in the US state of Kentucky. In Australia, a disaster occurs during the construction of a huge bridge in the centre of Melbourne. Heavy construction work shakes the earth in Oklahoma.

A devastating rail disaster outside a small North Dakota town results in cargo erupting in massive explosions; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an engineering flaw poised for catastrophic failure.
Bruce is keen to find some World War Two objects linked to D-Day and in doing so makes an amazing discovery.
The team travels to Serbia, Tesla's homeland, and discovers unseen documents drawn by Tesla himself. Meanwhile, the Death Ray build moves ahead.
Interstellar space is the space between the universe's stars. New discoveries reveal that it's not empty and unremarkable as previously thought.
New discoveries lead scientists to question if the Big Bang really happened. They investigate if it was the start of many multiverses.
Dark matter and energy battle for the cosmos and the winner will determine the universe's fate. New discoveries may reveal which force will win.
Rob heads to California to investigate a network for major fault lines that could set off a mega-quake. Plus, he explores a mysterious sinkhole.
Rob Nelson investigates a cluster of ancient ruins in New England that suggest Europeans arrived in the Americas almost 1,000 years before Columbus.
Half of the star systems in our galaxy have two stars, possibly creating habitats for alien life. Here, binary stars fling entire worlds into space.
Half of the star systems in our galaxy have not one, but two stars, possibly creating ideal habitats for alien life. Here, binary stars fling entire worlds into space.
An examination of the production processes of coconut charcoal, dial indicators, wet downdraft tables, and bassoon reeds.
Explores how items such as pasta dyes, blueberries, composting toilets, and surge arresters are made.
Explores the way items such as angle grinders, berry baskets, and omnidirectional speakers are made.
Find out how cartridge blades, chocolate banana loaves, vending machines, and dive computers are made.
How do they make the tank piercing super bullet? Plus, how do they forge the infamous torture weapon, the dentist's drill?
How do they make giant floating power stations that provide power around the world? Plus, how do they fabricate the world's smallest aircraft?
How do they create coloured crayons used by children and artists around the world? Plus, how do artisans and craftsmen create treasured mirrors in India?
How do they power the next generation of race cars that run on electricity? Plus, how do they make mead - the favourite drink of the infamous Vikings?

Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.
Experts investigate Apollo 11's lunar module that nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training. Some believe this proves why the moon landing is fake.
A series of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck Zukowski's team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident. Armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself.
A Missouri man who claims UFOs are stalking him contacts Chuck and the team for help. Their investigation uncovers a dark secret which may explain this reported activity.
Examining how everyday items such as CNC assembly machines, lemon tarts, and miniature war figures are made.
An examination of how items such as chemical tank pressure vents, candy wafers, food trucks, and traditional ropes are made.
Examines how items such as graphene, the world's smallest car, force testers, and composite cans are all made.
Find out how LED tubes, chocolate peanut butter bars, and robotic medication dispensers are made and why they are in demand.
Paul looks for answers in a 60-year-old string of unsolved cattle mutilations across the US. He heads to a remote Nebraska farm to uncover the truth.
Paul searches for evidence that extra-terrestrials are among us. He unearths long-buried files that could lead to an alien cover-up all the way to the White House.
Experts are hot on the trail of a legendary sea monster that reportedly lives in the underwater caves of the Bermuda Triangle; divers hunt for the deadly beast in underwater chambers.
New discoveries might finally explain the truth behind one of the Triangle's most infamous mysteries, when 306 US Navy crewmen vanished without a trace.
Following Aron's successful test of his Death Ray, Jack shifts his focus to Nikola Tesla's potential murder. The first suspect sends Jack and Cameron overseas to Serbia to look for clues.

Mike and Elvis take a gamble as they head to Germany and buy a neglected Audi RS2 that they can't test drive. This highly collectable estate car could earn them a bumper profit, but it could also turn into a €40k money pit.
Andy squeezes a Hemi engine into a Jeep Wrangler for a power boost. Meanwhile, Jeff revives an '86 RX-7 with a Corvette LT1 motor, and Tim rehabs a trashed Boston Whaler.
A long-time client wants his 2017 F250 Platinum 4x4 lifted and made off-road ready. The guys oblige with a handmade 22-inch lift on 42-inch custom tyres.
Mike and Elvis get to work on an iconic Japanese rally car: a Mitsubishi Lancer Evo7. It needs a total engine rebuild and a new look if it is to be king of the street racers once again.
The original Countach was the supercar of the 1970s. 50 years later, Lamborghini have created a new version with some electricity thrown in. Plus, the team test the BMW i4 M50.
The team test-drive the Kia 600hp EV6 the length of Norway, along the E6, Europe's longest road in a single country. Plus, Jason drives a Tesla SUV against a Porsche Macan.
The team test the Porsche Taycan, a sports car that gets to 62 mph in 2.8 seconds and up to 162 mph. And, Jimmy goes to Sweden to sample Volvo's plans to revolutionise trucking.
Henry and Fuzz rummage through David's hoard of Italian bikes in Norfolk.

A devastating railroad inferno takes down a vital route on a historic river crossing in Arizona; using the latest cutting-edge technology, experts investigate the remaining incinerated evidence to determine what caused such a disastrous derailment.

Just one month after the newly constructed Nipigon River Bridge opened, a winter storm caused a failure in all forty bolts attaching a main deck girder. The subsequent highway closure forced travellers to temporarily detour hundreds of kilometres.

An unprecedented cycle of freezing and thawing causes dramatic destruction to a landmark bridge in Pennsylvania; experts investigate and reveal how a sudden surge of icy flood water buckled pier foundations weakened from years of erosion.

Disaster strikes a new railway bridge as a crane collapses in the middle of major construction in Italy; experts investigate and uncover a compromise in balance with improperly positioned counterweights and a manoeuvre that resulted in catastrophe.
A crane disastrously falls across two lanes of traffic during construction work on a landmark bridge in New York City.
A Jensen Interceptor Mark III is the boys biggest rebuild yet. But when an estimate puts the bodywork at £25k, Paul wants to cut their losses and walk away.
With iconic Peugeot 205 GTI's more in demand than ever and prices rocketing, Drew and Paul gamble on restoring an insurance right-off.
An excited Drew and Paul get their hands on what has become known as "the poor man's Porsche", and set out to change the 914's reputation once and for all.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace mechanic Sam Lovegrove reminisce on their Best Bits from the last two series of 'Shed & Buried'. This time round, the two look back at their visit to Peter Bullen, a trials car enthusiast.
Henry and Sam remember Brian, whose Cornish cottage was like a transport museum chock-full of memorabilia, penny farthings and trinkets of all descriptions.
Bike guru Henry Cole and ace-mechanic Sam "The Engine Whisperer" Lovegrove remember their visit to Eamon's place in Oxfordshire, where they were searching for vintage treasure to restore.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are in Oxfordshire to rummage through a collection of vintage tractors and automobiles. They find a Suzuki SB200 and paraffin dispenser.

Richard Hammond trades his jet-setting lifestyle for a long-standing dream to set up a classic car restoration workshop close to his home in Herefordshire. With the help of skilled craftsmen, he navigates the ups and downs of building a new business.
Richard gambles his own money on a 1970 Mark II Jensen Interceptor with plans to restore it to factory specification. Plus, the guys head to the London Classic Car Show.
Steve and Sam get into deep trouble transporting a state-of-the-art Navy mine sweeper. Plus, Simon has his hands full shifting a monstrous rock-crusher to Kent.
Um Daisy zu beeindrucken, versucht sich Donald mit Mickys Hilfe als Segelbootkapitän.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

Micky bastelt mal wieder an seinem Flitzer herum. Doch etwas geht schief und aus Versehen endet das Ganze mit einem Monster-Truck. Das hatte er nicht beabsichtigt. Jetzt muss Micky sich überlegen, was er mit dem Truck anfängt.
Vampirina möchte Fahrradfahren lernen, um an einer Radrallye teilnehmen zu können.
Zsa-Zsa lernt, dass aus den Samen Obst und Gemüse heranwächst, wenn sie sich um sie kümmert.
Chili und Bandit sind sehr daran interessiert, einen neuen Pizzaofen wie ihre Nachbarn zu bekommen.
Als ein vorbeiziehender Kakadu eine Feder fallen lässt, hat Bingo eine Idee für ein neues Spiel.
Papa isst Bingos letzten Chip und als Rückzahlung hat Bingo drei Wünsche, die er verwenden kann.
Onkel Stripe und Bandit spielen eine Runde Squash mit der Hilfe von Bingo und Bluey.
Amadeus präsentiert stolz seinen Bienenstock. Die Freunde verhindern, dass Ultron alle vertreibt.
Animated, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Children

Ein berühmter Komiker akumatisiert sich in Psycomedian und kann nun jedem Emotionen auferlegen. Zu allem Überfluss hat er direkt Ladybug und Cat Noir als sein erstes Ziel auserkoren, um ihnen das Lächeln aus dem Gesicht auszumerzen.

Ladybug und Cat Noir treffen eine alte Bekannte. Su Han, die himmlische Hüterin des Wundersamen, taucht auf. Ladybug ist deswegen gezwungen, zu beweisen, dass sie von Meister Fu den Auftrag bekommen hat, die Wunderkiste zu bewachen.

Cap und Capper besuchen einen Jahrmarkt, um sich die Attraktionen anzusehen. Dabei bekommen sie mit, dass die beste Sängerin des Hundestreunerchors nach einem Streit mit dem Leiter Cash den Chor verlässt. Capper soll Dixies Platz einnehmen und vergisst seinen besten Freund Cap. Dixie erfährt, dass Capper kein Streuner ist, und schmiedet mit Caps Hilfe ein Komplott, um Capper aus dem Chor zu drängen.

Andy benutzt zu viel Parfüm und erweckt versehentlich Spong, einen stinkenden Geist. Mikroo muss aufgehalten werden. Dieser hat nämlich die Macht, alles, was er beängstigend findet, dramatisch zu schrumpfen, einschließlich der Ghostforce.

Als Liv mit Mike und Andy bei einer Talentshow auftreten soll, bekommt sie Lampenfieber und rennt weg. Professor Pascal lässt seine Klasse einige lebende Spinnen studieren. Mike ist entsetzt, denn er hat Arachnophobie. Doch auch Arakgum wird erweckt.

Viele New Yorker werden süchtig nach einem neuen Handyspiel. Auch Mike, der in der Rangliste nach oben klettert, ist davon betroffen, denn beim Spiel ZipZap springt ein elektronischer Geist von Bildschirm zu Bildschirm und friert alle ein.

Benedikt hat ja schon so einige unglaubliche Herausforderungen von Zuschauern gemeistert, aber diese scheint schlichtweg unmöglich zu sein: Diesmal soll er sich unsichtbar machen. Benedikt ist ratlos, denn solche Tricks kennt er nur von Zauberern.

Benedikt hat bekanntlich vor kaum etwas Angst, doch eine Sache bringt ihn zum Zittern: Tanzen. Nun muss er über sich hinaus wachsen und innerhalb von sechs Stunden drei verschiedene Tänze meistern oder sich der Strafaufgabe stellen.
Jojo und Patricia suchen im neuen Tierrätsel ein Lebewesen, das eine riesige Klappe hat.

Jojo ist sich sicher, dass er weiß, welches Tier gesucht wird. Was er jedoch nicht weiß: Er wird bei seiner Suche von Patricia verfolgt. Sie will beweisen, dass sie sich richtig gut verstecken kann. Ob Jojo auffällt, dass er beobachtet wird?

Mrs. Münzberg weilt über den Jahreswechsel mit Taffy und Bentley in einem Luxuschalet in den Bergen. Nachdem Blanche Taffy und Bentley in eisige Höhen verfrachtet hat, treten die beiden Streithähne nach einigem Hin und Her beherzt den Heimweg an.
Scratch versucht, den Büchergeist zu fangen. Darryl wird für einen Tag ein Geist.
Als Sharon eine Künstlerblockade hat, nehmen Molly und die Familie ihr alle Ablenkungen weg.
Libby bekommt ihre Periode. Die McGees machen Urlaub zu Hause.
Ein Geist ergreift Besitz von einer Puppe. Scratch sagt Pläne mit Geoff ab.

Nachdem ein mysteriöses Monster das Dach von Sheriff Blubs Auto abgerissen hat, machen sich Dipper und Soos auf die Suche nach dem Ungeheuer, um es zu fotografieren. Derweil überträgt Mabel Gronkel Stan für einen Augenblick die Verantwortung für Schwabbel, doch Stan passt nicht auf und das Schwein wird von einem Pterodactylus geschnappt und verschleppt. Mabel setzt alles daran, um Schwabbel nach Hause zu holen, doch alleine kann sie es nicht schaffen.

Gideon beschwört den bösen Geist Bill Cipher herauf, der ihm helfen soll, Gronkel Stans Safe zu öffnen und so an die Besitzurkunde des Mystery Shack zu gelangen. Die Zahlenkombination zum Öffnen des Safes befindet sich nur in Stans Kopf und so macht sich Bill Cipher auf in Stans Psyche - dicht gefolgt von Dipper, Mabel und Soos. In Stans Gedankenwelt findet Dipper lang ersehnte Antworten, während Mabel und Soos mit aller Kraft versuchen zu verhindern, dass der Code in Gideons Hände fällt.

Nachdem Gideon Stan die Besitzurkunde für den Mystery Shack abgeluchst hat, plant er, die Hütte abzureißen und "Gideon-Land" zu bauen. Doch damit nicht genug, verfolgt er noch weitaus dunklere Ziele! Mabel und Dipper müssen ihn aufhalten.
Gramma erzählt Cricket und Tilly, dass auf ihrem Grundstück ein Schatz vergraben ist.
Dad tut so als wäre er von gestern. Er lässt sich die Welt von Bingo und Bluey neu erklären.

Bluey heckt einen Plan aus, als Papa sich darüber beschwert, dass Bluey und Bingo anders und komplett unterschiedlich sind. Die Hündin lässt es sich daher nicht nehmen, die beiden ähnlicher zu machen und konzipiert daraus Mini Bluey.

Mama muss Bluey eine allerletzte Geschichte vorlesen, da sie ansonsten nicht einschlafen kann. Ihre Geschichte wird allerdings von dem schrägen Gemeinhorn unterbrochen, das die nervigste Handpuppe auf der ganzen Welt ist.
Als sie Curry holen, müssen Bingo und Dad einer Elster trotzen, die ihr Nest beschützt.

Bingo lernt von Bluey, wie man Mama so verzaubert, dass sie mit einem spielen will. Bluey hat dabei allerdings die wichtigste aller Regeln vergessen, dass man Zauberei nicht dafür nutzt, kleine Ungezogenheiten auszuüben.

Vincent Asa ist der größte Fan des Rockstars Jagged Stone und schleicht sich in Jaggeds Hotel, um ihn um ein Foto zu bitten. Als er aus dem Hotel geschmissen wird, nutzt Hawk Moth Vincents Wut und verwandelt ihn in den Pixelator.

Vor langer Zeit haben sich die Drachen in der Welt von Kumandra selbst geopfert, um die Menschheit vor unheimlichen Monstern, bekannt als die Druun, zu retten. Nun, 500 Jahre später, kehren diese Monster zurück und es liegt an der Kriegerin Raya, den letzten Drachen zu finden, um die Druun aufzuhalten. Auf ihrer Reise lernt sie jedoch, dass es mehr als einen Drachen benötigt, um das Schicksal zu beeinflussen und wieder Frieden nach Kumandra zu bringen.

Mulans alter, kranker Vater soll in die Armee eingezogen werden, um die einfallenden Mongolen zu bekämpfen. Da er in seinem Zustand die Strapazen des Krieges nicht überleben würde, verkleidet sich die junge Mulan als Mann und gibt sich als ihr Vater aus. Ihre Vorfahren sind mit diesem Plan nicht einverstanden und schicken deshalb den kleinen Drachen Mushu hinterher, um sie von ihrem Vorhaben abzubringen. Doch als er Mulan begegnet, schlägt er sich auf ihre Seite.

Der geschiedene Scott bekommt am Weihnachtsabend Besuch von seinem Sohn Charlie. Als er ihn zu Bett bringen will, sehen sie Santa Claus vom Dach fallen. Dieser verschwindet zwar, doch seine Kleidung und eine Karte bleiben zurück. Auf der Karte steht, dass wer auch immer Santas Mantel nach dessen Tode trägt, zum neuen Santa wird. Scott und Charlie fahren daraufhin mit Santas Rentierschlitten zum Nordpol, wo der Weihnachtself Bernard Scott unterrichtet. So beginnt ein wundersames Abenteuer.

Als Claires Bauanfrage für den Hinterhof abgelehnt wird, kennen nur Phil und Luke den wahren Grund. Derweil verrät Pameron Cam ein Familiengeheimnis. Dieser ist dermaßen schockiert, dass er sich Hilfe von einem Therapeuten holt.

Als Phil starke Bauchschmerzen hat, bringt Gloria ihn für eine Notoperation ins Krankenhaus und versammelt die ganze Familie an seiner Seite. Unterdessen ist Cam wütend auf Mitchell, da sich dieser für einen anderen Mann interessiert.

Shane und Lacey streiten sich heftig, doch um in der Wildnis Südafrikas zu überleben, müssen sie zusammenhalten. An einem Wassertümpel versucht die Gruppe, Fische zu fangen, doch das stellt sich als ziemlich schwierig heraus.

Nach 21 Tagen sind den verbliebenen Teilnehmern die schweren Strapazen in der Savanne deutlich anzumerken. Dann verletzt sich auch noch Lacey, als sie im Camp ins Lagerfeuer stürzt und sich die Hand in der heißen Glut verbrennt.

Trotz ihrer verletzten Hand will Lacey nicht nur weitermachen, sondern sogar auf eigene Faust ihr Glück versuchen. Die anderen Kandidaten haben für dieses lebensgefährliche Vorhaben wenig Verständnis. Aber sie müssen für ihr eigenes Überleben sorgen.

Die Abenteurer verfolgen unterschiedliche Survival-Strategien, was zu Konflikten in der Gruppe führt. Um in der Wildnis zu überleben, müssen sie jedoch zusammenarbeiten. Gary versucht, die Gruppe nach Kräften zu unterstützen.

Die Feuerwehr rettet nicht nur Menschen, sondern auch Tiere aus Notsituationen. In Mainz müssen die Einsatzkräfte ein Reh einfangen, das auf der Flucht vor einem Hund durch den Rhein von Hessen nach Rheinland-Pfalz geschwommen ist.

In Mainz brennt ein Kamin und durch starke Rauchentwicklung droht an Ort und Stelle akute Gefahr. Die Berufsfeuerwehr muss schnell handeln, denn bei dem Einsatz ist Eile geboten. Außerdem breitet sich in einem Hochhaus in Chemnitz Rauchgase aus.

Die Beamten machen in Andalusien eine unerwartete Entdeckung im Inneren eines Krankenwagens. Ein junger Mann will mit dem Wagen nach Marokko übersetzen und auch die Papiere sind in Ordnung, doch im Inneren befinden sich gestohlene Motorräder.
Im zweitgrößten Land der Erde liefert Stefan Zellweger Maschinen an verschiedene Baustellen.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Nach 40 Stunden Transport hat Mario Tänzer gemeinsam mit seinem Team das 40 Tonnen schwere Heckteil eines U-Boots in sein Fahrzeugmuseum in Benneckenstein gebracht. Doch U-16 ist noch nicht an seinem endgültigen Liegeplatz angekommen.

Ein Kunde will ein 7000 Dollar teures Armband ohne Beleg im "American Jewelry and Loan" auslösen. Doch ohne einen Beleg dafür, dass der Mann tatsächlich der Besitzer des Armbands ist, kann Pfandleiher Les Gold gar nichts machen. Der Mann hat nicht einmal einen Ausweis ins Geschäft mitgenommen. Deshalb muss der Pfandhaus-Besitzer den angeblichen Besitzer des kostbaren Schmuckstücks wieder nach Hause schicken.

Auf einer Großbaustelle in der Steiermark wurde ein großer Turmdrehkran zerlegt. Für die Seilbahn sind die Elemente zu groß, deshalb werden sie per Helikopter auf die 2700 Meter hohe Dachstein-Gipfelstation transportiert.

In Ebensee beladen Bergleute Waggons mit Kalkstein. Bruchleiter Helmut behält das Geschehen genau im Auge, denn die Brocken können schnell zum tödlichen Geschoss werden. In Teisendorf wird unterdessen jedes Jahr rund 100.000 Hektoliter Bier gebraut.

Kapitän Eike und seine Besatzung stechen in Wilhelmshaven mit einem Versorgungsschiff der Marine in See. Im Logistikzentrum eines bekannten Onlineversandhändlers in Baden-Württemberg sortieren die Angestellten derweil täglich über 60.000 Pakete.

In San Antonio treffen Matt Paxton und sein Team in einem Messie-Haus auf massiven Ungezieferbefall. Wegen zahlreicher Ratten und Kakerlaken kann die beschwerliche Räumung des Anwesens nur unter strengen Schutzmaßnahmen in Schutzkleidung erfolgen.
Mats ist auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung. Da weckt ein alter Mustang sein Interesse.

Pierre Michaux erfand in den 1860ern das erste Fahrrad mit Pedalantrieb. Eine Fahrt damit war äußerst holprig auf dem schmiedeeisernen Gestell mit Holzrädern. Drew hat genauso ein Exemplar in Cheshire entdeckt und möchte es kaufen.

Wo viele nur alten Plunder sehen, geht Drew Pritchard auf Schatzsuche. Seine Leidenschaft sind Antiquitäten. In Großbritannien führt er einen großen Trödelmarkt. Inzwischen hat er sich ein breites Wissen angeeignet und findet wahre Schmuckstücke.

In den Türen, im Armaturenbrett und unter dem Sitz: Der Zoll in Algeciras hat in einem Lieferwagen aus Tanger gefälschte Luxusuhren gefunden. Der Fahrer behauptet, es handele sich um Geschenke für seine Freunde. Trotzdem ist ein Bußgeld fällig. Und in Barcelona eilen Beamte der Flughafensicherheit zum Gate 22. Denn der Pilot einer ankommenden Maschine hat per Funk einen störenden Passagier gemeldet. Der Mann ist offenbar alkoholisiert und reist in Begleitung eines kleinen Jungen.
Der Zoll interessiert sich am Flughafen Barcelona-El-Prat für das Gepäck eines Reisenden aus Ghana. Der Mann führt in seinen Koffern jede Menge Kosmetika und Pflegeprodukte mit.

In Gioia Tauro an der Küste des Tyrrhenischen Meers werden jedes Jahr mehr als 13 Tonnen Kokain beschlagnahmt. Denn die kalabrische Mafia nutzt den größten Containerhafen Italiens als Drogenumschlagplatz, deswegen gibt die Zollpolizei ihr Bestes.

Am Flughafen Fiumicino trägt ein Passagier aus der Demokratischen Republik Kongo ungewöhnliches Handgepäck bei sich. Der kleine Kühlschrank mit einem Fassungsvermögen von rund 20 Litern erregt die Aufmerksamkeit der Beamten vom Zoll.

Ein Mann hat sich mit seinem Wagen bei überhöhter Geschwindigkeit auf der Autobahn viermal überschlagen. Im Schockraum des Elisabeth-Krankenhauses in Mönchengladbach-Rheydt kristallisiert sich heraus.
Der Rettungsdienst bringt einen betrunkenen Patienten in Begleitung der Polizei ins Sana-Klinikum in Lübeck. Die Sanitäter haben die Beamten zu ihrem eigenen Schutz angefordert.

Der Fahrer eines silbernen Golfs hat offenbar etwas zu verbergen, doch der Versuch, das verdächtige Vehikel mit einer Nagelkette zu stoppen, schlägt fehl. Deshalb greifen Jim Carrington und seine Polizeikollegen zu anderen Mitteln.

In einem Vorort von Nottingham klicken die Handschellen. Die Police Interceptors nehmen bei einer Razzia in einem Pub vier Personen fest. Mit einer Drohne halten die Einsatzkräfte in der Nachbarschaft nach einem weiteren Verdächtigen Ausschau.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.
Dropped into the South China Sea, 12 elite survivalists try to survive 40 days on land and sea. Two all-star survivalists start a 60-day challenge in the Philippines.
With resources dwindling, the survivalists risk their lives entering the shark-infested South China Sea in search of a meal they all desperately need.
Julia must remove a deadly snake from a frightened couple's garage. And Julia and trainee Conway deal with a constrictor snake near a youth centre.
Julia and her husband John deal with a snake hiding in the doorway of a house. Plus, a family with a baby have spotted a snake in their hoover.
Julia helps a customer deal with a python in their garden with a particularly big belly. Plus, Julia and John race to get a python out of a tree.
One team breaks all records, unearthing the biggest gold nugget ever found on television. Neville and Mick are hampered by a run-in with one of the deadliest snakes on the planet.
Hard rain threatens to drown the season for the `Dirt Dogs'. Meanwhile, remote prospectors Kellie and Henri hit a hot streak, and the `Gold Gypsies' come across a once-in-a- lifetime find.
The Victoria Diggers' million-dollar dream is nearly at breaking point. Plus, the Dirt Dogs hunt down gold thieves and the Mahoneys stumble across a mysterious murder.
Extreme hoarder Floyd's home has been deemed so unsafe that he must clear his hoard or risk losing his three-year-old son Charlie.
Donny has been to jail twice because of his hoard and his freedom is in jeopardy yet again. Elsewhere, while Joyce sees comfort in her doll collection, everyone else sees a creepy obsession.
International wildlife biologist Forrest Galante and Jessica Evans travel the world in search of rare and elusive wildlife, including those lost to science and mysterious cold-water sharks.

Josh Gates boldly explores members' most heart-pounding journeys into space. Apollo 13 astronauts fight to bring their crippled spacecraft 238,000 miles back to Earth and futuristic SpaceShipOne could give the rest of us a chance to travel to space.
Ed Stafford risks his life facing off against Max Djenohan, a young elite fighter on a quest to test his own capabilities, in Northern Kenya's volcanic barrier.
Phil tracks what could be an unknown species, while Jess hunts for evidence that a legendary creature is nearby.

Die 16-jährige Laura zieht mit ihrem Vater und ihrem jüngeren Bruder nach München. Von ihren neuen Mitschülern wird sie alles andere als herzlich empfangen, denn ihre neue Schule ist von festen Cliquen bevölkert, die es Neuen schwer machen.

Susanne, die Wirtin von der Lahn, zieht mit ihrer Schauspieltruppe nach Paris. Napoleon hat sie eingeladen, nachdem sie seine Majestät vor einem Attentat bewahrt hatte. Auf einem verlassenen Landschlösschen macht die Gesellschaft Rast.
Eine Auswahl beliebter Schlager vereint unvergessliche Melodien und zeitlose Genre-Klassiker.

Agostino Celli wird für verrückt gehalten, weil er behauptet, ein Gerät entwickelt zu haben, mit dem man zum Zeitpunkt der Ausstrahlung in eine Fernsehsendung eindringen kann. Nur sein Freund, der Publizist Giorgio Bonetti, glaubt ihm, und so setzt er alles daran, seinen Freund aus einer psychiatrischen Klinik zu befreien. Sobald er frei ist, setzt Agostino seine Erfindung sofort zugunsten von Giorgios Tante ein, der Besitzerin einer kleinen Kuchenfabrik.

Ob Sonne, Regen, Sturm oder Schnee - bei uns sind Sie immer aktuell informiert. Sehen Sie mehrmals tagsüber im Programm den Wetterbericht mit der Vorhersage für ganz Deutschland. Kompakt, schnell und verlässlich!

In dieser Sendung werden der bekannte Schlagersänger Ronny und seine größten Hits vorgestellt. Eingängige Melodien wie "Dunja Du", "Hohe Tannen", "Oh My Darling Caroline" oder "Sierra Madre del Sur" und "Kleine Annabell" werden präsentiert.
In der Sendung wird dieses Mal beliebte Sendung "Musikantenstadl" noch einmal beleuchtet.

Der linkische Studienrat Dr. Eddi Frank ist Lehrer an einem Jungeninternat und mit dem weiblichen Geschlecht ganz und gar unerfahren. Ausgerechnet er wird eines Tages nach Seefelden in ein Mädcheninternat versetzt. Hoch motiviert übernimmt er die dortige Abiturklasse, der er Disziplin beibringen soll. Doch schon nach wenigen Stunden stellen die frechen Mädchen den letzten Hauch von Autorität ihrer Lehrkraft infrage.

Im Eros-Center kommt es zu einem Mord. Eine junge Frau namens Biggi wurde ermordet. Die Polizei hat schnell drei Hauptverdächtige. Zum einen ist da ihr italienischer Freund. Riccardo und sie haben sich angeblich am Abend vor ihrem Tod gestritten. Ein Rechtsanwalt war Kunde bei Biggi und diese hat seine perversen Wünsche wohl nicht mitmachen wollen. Außerdem ist da noch ein amerikanischer Journalist. Der hat an einer Reportage gearbeitet und alles dafür getan, um an Material zu kommen.
A celebration of the naughtiest bits of 'Naked Attraction', revisiting the good, the bad and the kinky, from a polyamorous couple and a three-time picker to food fetishes and whipped cream.

The armchair critics watch the revamped 'Gladiators', get loved up with 'First Dates: Be My Valentine', and give their takes on the movie 'Saltburn'. Plus: 'Trigger Point', 'Bring the Drama', 'The Repair Shop' and BBC News on Joe Biden.

Two teachers head out on a double date, but when they run into familiar bar patrons, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction; at Ava's first book club meeting, the group ends up in a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader.
A recent transfer student named Diggs (Daniel Radcliffe) rescues Bart from a confrontation with bullies.
Erica thinks her singing dreams have come true when she lands a job at a new karaoke bar in town. Murray teaches Barry and Lainey financial responsibility.
When Adam tells Beverly he doesn't want her to chaperone the school trip to a theme park, his mother tries to manipulate him with `guilt letters'.
Phil is invited to appear on the local news in a real estate segment and Jay is helping Manny prepare his video interview for college applications.
Halloween parties create hilarious mishaps and confrontations as everyone tries to get through the scary night.
Phil considers becoming a member at Jay's favourite place of refuge. Claire is mistaken about her influence on Alex's choices. Cam refrains from telling Mitchell what his play is really about.
It's Vegas baby. Groom Simon and best man Anthony sit down and pour over the decisions that led to Simon gambling it all on an explosive Las Vegas wedding to bride Kayleigh.

Short cheeky clips feature ducks going up an escalator, animal impressions, a few narrow escapes on a snowboard and rally driving. Plus, some interesting food clips with an energy drink house prank, and a butcher rap.
Billy plans a pig-themed wedding involving a world record parade of porkers, but prim Steph may kick up a stink at his plans.
Aussie-born Adam is taking a risk planning an '80s Aussie soap' wedding when bride-to-be Rachel is hoping for something classy and sophisticated.

Beks learns the truth from Freddy about the love bite on his neck. Will Jazz's moment of comfort with Inga affect her relationship with Eve? And after hearing that Jules' mother has been hinting at grandchildren, Tristan asks James Taylor for advice.

Gordon visits Italian bistro Charlie's in La Verne, Southern California, which was bought in 2010 by Tatiana Leiva, her mother and her sister. Tatiana didn't actually put any money into the purchase herself, but her hard-working mother and sister did because they felt they were helping to fulfil Tatiana's dream. They even put up their houses as collateral! Unfortunately, soon Charlie's was in trouble.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Baltimore to try to turn around a restaurant that is suffering because its owner, Denise Whiting, has managed to alienate the surrounding community. When Denise opened Café Hon in 1992 it was a roaring success, but as a result of her unwavering business ambition the local community decided to boycott the restaurant, leaving Denise frustrated by falling sales.

Gordon Ramsay travels to South Philadelphia to try to turn around family-run restaurant Chiarella's, which is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian establishments. That isn't the only problem facing owners Tommy and Dina Defino. Their marriage is on the verge of collapse.
Chef Ramsay returns to restaurants he tried to help in the past, such as Downcity in Providence, RI, Classic American in West Babylon, NY, and Davide in Boston to check on their progress.
Chef Ramsay revisits La Frite, Kingston Cafe, Capri and Spanish Pavilion to see if the owners succeeded in following his advice.

When a straight-laced fire superintendent and his elite team of firefighters come to the rescue of three siblings, they quickly realize that no amount of training could prepare them for their most challenging job yet - babysitting.

When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court. The restaurant offers a peace deal: Homer can eat all the food he likes so long as people can gawk at him like a freak in return. Meanwhile, Bart falls in love with his babysitter.
Homer becomes a neighbourhood hero when, after wrecking his car in the snow, he buys a snowplough and clears his neighbours' driveways.

The family struggles to get Maggie to say her first word. Homer says he's glad that Maggie has not spoken yet because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him, but after he puts Maggie to bed, she says her first word.
When Homer learns he needs a heart bypass operation after having a heart attack at work, he searches for the cheapest doctor.

When Springfield decides to install a monorail system, Homer gets the job as conductor, but has no idea what he's doing, although he does get to wear a cape. When the monorail opens, all hell breaks loose, and it's down to Homer and Bart to save the passengers.
After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Aunt Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park, with near-disastrous consequences.

When Homer leaves Bart by the squid port and strangers take pity on the street urchin, giving him money, Homer and Bart turn to a life of scamming. They scam Dr Hibbert and Ned Flanders, and Grampa even helps them con his fellow retirement home residents, but are they accomplished enough to avoid detection?

The Great British Bake Off celebrates Christmas 2022 with five famous faces from Channel 4's history. Gaby Roslin, Sir Tony Robinson, Miquita Oliver, Terry Christian and Claire Sweeney enter the tent, each hoping to win Christmas Star Baker.

The nation's favourite armchair critics cast their eyes over 2023's top Christmas telly, including 'The Real Full Monty: Jingle Bells', 'The Repair Shop Christmas Special', 'The 1% Club Christmas Special', 'Fur Babies', 'Love Actually' and more.

This week, the Goggleboxers have been watching 'Britain's Got Talent', 'Married at First Sight Australia', 'Chess Masters: The Endgame', 'The Au Pair', 'This Morning', 'The Americas', 'Inside the Four Seasons Park Lane' and 'With Love, Meghan'.

This time on Gogglebox it's 'The Great Celebrity Bake Off for Stand Up To Cancer', 'With Love', 'Meghan', 'Tempting Fortune', 'Fear', 'Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code', 'Last One Laughing', 'Jeopardy' and 'This Morning (toenails)'.
Charlotte Ritchie climbs a ladder with some loo roll, Mike Wozniak tries out a new catchphrase, and Lee Mack terrifies an innocent member of the public.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Rob Beckett and Aisling Bea are joined by competing panellists Kerry Godliman, Georgia Toffolo, Kiri Pritchard-McLean and Fin Taylor.

Jimmy Carr hosts the game show mash-up as Sean Lock and Kevin Bridges take on Joe Wilkinson and Victoria Coren Mitchell. Adam Kay joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers.
In Portsmouth, Claire and Alex, Jack and Robyn, and Elle and Graham compete in an edition that features organic fare, glitter and sparkle, and some school dinner comparisons.

Maddi and her husband Givon start the competition with a menu inspired by their Sri Lankan heritage. Second to host are Kate and Dan who prepare a night of rustic Italian cooking, and finally it's time for Ali and John to step up to the plate.

When Ilca and Fernando bought their starter home it was just the two of them. However, ten years and three kids later, they are juggling childcare, an in-home salon, and a long list of unfinished DIY.
Newlyweds and empty-nesters Lisa and Dave are ready to downsize, and they are looking for an open-concept suburban palace where they can entertain their big blended family in style.

In the year that same-sex marriage became legal in England, former drama student Jack from Essex is hoping to impress his husband-to-be James by putting on the performance of a lifetime, as well as a wedding.

In this Christmas Special, a loving couple from Rotherham switch roles as the groom takes on all wedding planning responsibility. Steve gets 12,000 pounds and three weeks to plan a wedding with an icy twist.

Wannabe superstar DJ Luke wants a huge rave for his wedding to bride-to-be Ellis, while all Ellis wants is a quiet church ceremony. But with a mother-in-law to impress and laid-back Luke leaving everything to the last minute, can he and party animal best man Tom get this party started?
Club Med Europe Africa Middle East CEO Xavier Mufraggi goes undercover at his holiday parks.
Wan Kim, CEO of Smoothie King, goes undercover at one of his stores.

In Beaver, Pennsylvania, where he finds a brother-and-sister team who are unable to work together positively at an Italian restaurant called Levanti's. Their relationship is so fractured that they are failing to save their father's business from being overwhelmed by competition from other local eateries. The situation has become desperate, and dad Tony is now in danger of losing his life savings.

Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

Gordon heads to Long Beach, California, to save Nino's, an Italian family restaurant that was opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of the eldest son, Nino. Younger brother Michael and sister Carina point the finger of blame for the restaurant's failings directly at Nino, and their 78-year-old mother Inge is desperate for Nino to turn the business around.

Gordon heads to Norwalk, Ohio, in America's farming heartland, for the first of two visits to the Mill Street Bistro. There he encounters Joe Nagy, one of the most pretentious restaurant owners he has ever met.
In the dramatic conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with proprietor Joe Nagy erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet.

Jimmy Carr hosts, with Sean Lock and Jason Manford going up against guest captain Sarah Millican, and Jonathan Ross. Bill Bailey joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner while Rachel Riley looks after the letters and the numbers.

Join Edinburgh Comedy Award Newcomer nominee Joe as he tackles the tyranny of Post Office jobsworths, confronts the stupidity of celebrities on Twitter and accidentally gets into an argument with Isis (not that one) in this Chortle Award-winning show recorded at the Duchess Theatre in London's West End.
Jimmy Carr hosts the topical comedy panel show, with team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock. The teams are joined by celebrity guests Fern Brady, Carol Vorderman, Phil Spencer and Henning Wehn.
Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by celebrity guests Henning Wehn, Rob Beckett, Kate Humble and Alex Brooker.
Mirthsome moments courtesy of Ronnie's Barker and Corbett. The highlights here include "Fête Worse Than Death" and "Effingham Hall". Special guest Clodagh Rodgers sings "Heartache".
Ronnies B and C offer up more classic comedy. Humorous highlights include the spoof serial Death Can Be Fatal and the musical finale Abdication Street.
More classic comedy from The Ronnies. In the spoof serial Death Can Be Fatal, a clumsy drug is undermining the great and good.

Sketches include Spoonerisms and part four of Death Can Be Fatal. Michel Legrand performs Theme from Summer of '42. In the musical finale the Ronnies sing songs from Oh What A Lovely War as John Mills and Mrs Mills.
Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien head to the Midlands. Henry's rather taken with a throne from an exotic nightclub and Simon's restoration of a Victorian doll's house doesn't go to plan.

Henry and Simon are back travelling Britain seeking items to fix up and flog on, to make a handsome profit for their owners. They visit a Norman castle and restore a Fiat 500 as well as build a table from part of Southend Pier.
Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien seek out old item to fix up and turn for profit. Henry restores two quad bikes and a sun lounger while Simon rescues a canoe and turns an oak beam into a spice rack.
Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien visit Essex, where Henry restores a car trailer and a 1970s racing bike, and Simon turns his attentions to lovingly restoring a vintage model aircraft.

The night might be a time humans avoid, but for most mammals it has always been a world of opportunity. Mammals first emerged during the time of the dinosaurs. To avoid competition with these mighty rivals, they stayed small and only active at night.

For millions of years, mammals have evolved to master every environment on Earth, but the planet is changing rapidly, all thanks to one mammal in particular: humans. As mankind reshapes the world, mammals must change with it if they are to survive.

A look at some of the most intimate and surprising behaviours of marine mammals. Raising the bar of human understanding of how whales and dolphins make their lives at sea, as well as meeting terrestrial mammals that dip their toes into the water.

Having honed their survival strategies over millennia, mammals have evolved to be masters of the cold. From icy seas to snow-capped mountains, a look at the unique mammals that call these frozen worlds home.

After leaving the Metropolitan Police, Whicher saves a respectable country lady from a violent robbery in a dangerous quarter of London. Susan Spencer is desperately hunting for her vulnerable niece Mary, who came to London in search of Stephen Gann, the young man who had made her pregnant, and Susan commissions Jack Whicher as a private inquiry agent to find her niece and the young man.
A helicopter crash leaves Bob and his translator stranded in Siberia. As they battle for survival in the extreme conditions, Bob has flashbacks to the selection process that got him into the Unit.
Marks on the bodies of a publisher, his son and other ruthless men indicate they were killed by a giant bird.
In order to get an Aztec mask that is worth a fortune, John Mannering makes a deal with a crooked insurance agent.
The dangers of helping a damsel in distress are highlighted for Danny and Brett when their efforts lead to a kidnapping charge.

A mission to hunt and destroy a dangerous German battleship in the Baltic goes wrong when the British submarine runs short on fuel. A crew member with a flair for the German language is forced to disembark on an enemy-occupied Danish island.

The commander of Air Station Kodiak retires, but that does not mean that the work slows down. The Coast Guard ramps up on dramatic search and rescue cases including a flight to collect a fisherman who has gone overboard.
The Coast Guard rushes to a medevac in the remote Bering Sea. They also help out a vessel taking on water and save two fishermen who have serious accidents.
In 1881 Percy Lefroy Mapleton, a talented young writer, became fixated on a beautiful stage actress.
Never in the field of human conflict was so much owed by so many to so few. Looking into the history of events that lead to the Battle of Britain.
Revealing how Hitler cheated death for so long. Alpine isolation proved a tempting target for many of Hitler's enemies, including the SAS.

Set in Mexico in 1916, a major branded a coward by his disgruntled commanding officer who bears a grudge because of his own failure to rise in the ranks. He sends the major and a party on a suicide mission into the desert, knowing full well they are unlikely to survive. Instead, the major displays his real strength, and eventually gains the respect of the seemingly doomed expedition.
Taking the viewer back in time with a look at news headlines from this week, back then.
A law enforcement cowboy, about to retire, aims to go out in a blaze by going on a crusade against local villains. However, his resolve weakens when an attractive musical star arrives in town.

Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John, a gunfighter, and Tom, a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan.
Tracker Joe Kidd is hired by vengeful rancher Harlan to lead his hunters to a Mexican bandit but when Kidd sees Harlan's viciousness in action, he switches to the other side.
A man carries out his own agenda for justice after a judge encourages him to round up the men who tried to lynch him.
When a romance writer is murdered, matchmaker Angie Dove and Detective Kyle Cooper must read between the lines to find the killer.

The team explores Harlan County's courthouse and jail, seeking evidence of apparitions, eerie voices and other unexplained phenomena. This grim execution site may still harbour echoes of a revenge killing and the region's coal wars.

The team conducts a thorough investigation at White Hall manor, seeking the alleged screaming ghost of legislator Cassius Marcellus Clay. They delve into the life of this uncompromising political figure who is said to haunt the halls.
The team investigates the history of an Old Louisville house where almost every member of the mysterious Brennan family died.

New equipment helps investigators contact familiar spirits at the Conrad-Caldwell House Museum. Fresh data and insights into the Kentucky Anomaly may aid Brandon in uncovering the core of this haunting.
When toys take on a life of their own it's too much for one homeowner, and he wants nothing more to do with his haunted flat.

Return to Jailer's Inn, where the team's first investigation finds a moving ball of environmental changes that registered on multiple metres. See if they can replicate their results as they investigate reports of voices and footsteps from upstairs.

The hunt is on for the ghost brother of Diamond Point's building director, who still feels his presence in the city welcome centre. Investigators explore apparitions, voices, and phantom smells that keep popping up in the former family home.
Probe the eerie Civil War apparitions inside a Confederate general's home.

Struggling with the loss of her childhood best friend and reluctant to discuss her pain, Carrie finds solace during a solitary horse ride. There, a paranormal event shifts her perspective on the possibility of life after death.
A tall, shadowy figure violently attacks a ten-year-old boy in his new home.
During a snow storm, a hospital worker stays the night alone and is startled when he sees the ghosts of staff and patients from World War I.
When Amy and her mother move into a deceased friend's home, they sense they are not alone.
The spirit of a family's dead cat fights against a mysterious canine presence.
In a Scottish castle, a ghostly apparition orders a mother and daughter to leave.
A 12-year-old boy senses something terrifying in the basement.
A frightened woman defends herself against a threatening figure in her new house.

In Ontario cottage country, an investigator is stalked by a terrifying beast-like entity; in Ohio, Karlo and his team are frozen in fear when they come face to face with the ghost of an executioner on an old jail's death row.
Michelle Desrochers' dream trip to Transylvania turns into a nightmare, while in New York, paranormal investigators are attacked by a dangerous entity stalking an old church.
The spirit of a murderer tries to possess an investigator in an Ohio library, and a woman is terrorised by shadow-like figures in her home in Massachusetts.
A woman and her teenage daughter are terrorised by apparitions, while in Arizona, something sinister is found lurking in an abandoned factory.
A member of the team suffers a potentially fatal paranormal attack in a prison in Ohio, and a mother and son in Phoenix are tormented by a spirit.

Summoning the 18th-century buccaneers who ran a South Carolina port in the golden age of piracy, uncovering the truth about a ghost ship and a creepy bedroom in the city's oldest tavern, and confronting a spirit stalking one of the investigators.

The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie bed and breakfast, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.

Sailing to Bell Island, Newfoundland, where the investigators reach out to the ghosts left by a devastating Nazi U-boat attack during WW II, and descending into darkness as the trio reveals a group of ghostly miners trapped underground for 80 years.
Paranormal investigators tap into the history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots as they find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress.
A woman claims to be tormented by apparitions. The story of a teen being attacked by a demonic beast. Rocky Primiani shares his story of encounters with the afterlife.

Investigative documentary exploring the construction of the Mauthausen concentration camp. In 1938, Hitler ordered the construction of the camp, one of the deadliest in history. Some 200,000 people would be deported there. Over 120,000 would perish.
The US Navy trained nearly 15,000 pilots on Lake Michigan from 1942-1945, resulting in the sinking of more than 100 classic World War II fighters and dive bombers.
The documentary details the Bismarck's search and sinking, featuring naval historians and Angus Konstam.
Hoping to find a sense of normalcy, six female Holocaust survivors immigrate to America, get married and raise children.

A look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including a baby doll, Elsa Ury's suitcase, camp children's tales, the gas chamber door, Karl Hocker's album, a cracked thermos flask, and an SS Licence Plate.
A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, a former Nazi concentration and extermination camp and the world's largest cemetery.

A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau including a sketchbook, various stolen objects, a little white house, Hoss's gallows, Roma portraits, and a double portrait.

A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including a little shoe and suitcase, the central sauna, collar tabs, Bilderbuch and Sonderkommando photos.
A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including soup kettles, a snuff box, the crematorium furnace, the camp model and a Totenbuch.

A documentary that sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the perspective of six women imprisoned in the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The film demonstrates the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships. Instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to encourage one another and retain their humanity in the face of unimaginable evil.

Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.

This documentary programme uses archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstructions to tell the story of the rise of the Nazis through time as well as the continued rise of Neo-Nazis. `The Rise of the Nazi Party' reveals how the National Socialists exploited economic turmoil to get into power in Germany in 1933 before leading the nation into an era of genocide and military defeat. It profiles the people who helped the Nazis bring destruction to Europe, including Hitler, Himmler and Goebbels.
As punishment for the 1923 'Putsch', Hitler is banned from public speaking. Now he employs Joseph Goebbels to feed Hitler's political ideology to the masses.
Hitler seizes his chance in the wake of The Great Depression, turning the people on the incumbent Democratic Weimar Government and promising a brighter future.
A month after coming to power, Hitler addresses his people through the radio. He promises to make the economy his priority - and the task ahead is massive.
Hitler summons Germany's military leaders to a shock meeting at his headquarters. He lays out his plans for military expansion into neighbouring territories.
Investigate Hitler's biggest mistake, and explore how the German people begin to see through the facade of the Nazi propaganda machine.
Explore how Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party groomed the German people into thinking the genocide of Jewish people was a morally correct decision.
Explore how with Nazi Germany on the back foot, Hitler's attempts to cling to power become ever more desperate, leading to ever more deplorable consequences.
Explore how the Allies final advance on Nazi Germany in January 1945 sounded the death knell for the Third Reich, a regime which continued with its lies to the very end.

In the darkest days of World War II in the Pacific, an elite British military team sought to facilitate espionage and sabotage behind enemy lines. This now famous group, the British Special Operations Executive or MI6, faced a critical obstacle.
Kevin Sempé dives in search of wrecks harking back to the Roman Empire's greatness. The journey begins with the Nave Romana.
Kevin Sempé explores the bay of Saint-Pierre in Martinique, where ships smouldered and sank following the devastating volcanic eruption of 1902.

The history of modern China is told from the birth of the republic in 1911, through the civil war, the bloody Japanese occupation, the rise to power of Mao and the Communist Party, the Cultural Revolution, to the present day.
Explore how the Polynesians spread across the Pacific and examine the cultures they took with them while constructing elaborate temples to their beliefs.

Alice visits Canterbury for the story of Plantagenet England. Canterbury is steeped in history and the era of the Plantagenets - the strong house that held the English throne from 1154 until 1485 - saw the most dramatic episodes in the city's story.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Edinburgh's handsome hilltop bastion is Scotland's most popular paid tourist attraction. With a slew of sieges to its name, it is no surprise that the site boasts some formidable defences, and Dan puts one heavy-duty cannon through its paces.

Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff Castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.

In medieval England, the North was ruled from York. Dan Jones explores the history of its castle, from the Viking Jorvik and the Normans, through the dark days of the anti-Jewish pogrom and the imprisonment of the Knights Templar, to one of its most colourful inmates - the legendary highwayman Dick Turpin.

With the aid of dramatic reconstruction, Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of the beautiful Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor and Norman stronghold to the private property of six medieval queens, a Tudor palace, a Jacobean country house, a Georgian mansion and an elegant 20th-century retreat for the rich and famous.

Dan Jones visits Lancaster Castle to explore its grisly history of crime and punishment, including the infamous Lancashire Witches trials and the martyrdom of the Jesuit priest Saint Edmund Arrowsmith.
Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

Dan is in the heart of the English countryside at Warwick Castle. While it appears idyllic today, for centuries it was a poisoned chalice to the Earls of Warwick who lived there and its walls echo with tales of betrayal, bloodshed and murder.
Historian Dan Jones is in the heart of Snowdonia exploring a stronghold built not only as an impenetrable fortress but also as a lavish royal palace fit for a fairytale - Caernarfon Castle.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.

Dan Jones explores the turbulent history of Carrickfergus, one of the most ancient castles in Northern Ireland and a stronghold that holds the key to understanding the tempestuous relationship between Britain and Ireland.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska und besichtigt ein aufwendig renoviertes Raketensilo. Danach besucht er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Vergangenheit und entdeckt zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

Jack besichtigt in Palm Springs das ehemalige Zuhause einer Hollywood-Legende. Dann reist er ins Goldgräberland und entdeckt eine ungewöhnliche Lösung für Stauraum, bevor es an den Lake Tahoe geht, wo nachhaltiges Bauen im Mittelpunkt steht.

Jacks Reise führt ihn zu drei weiteren außergewöhnlichen Häusern. Er entdeckt ein Haus mit musikalischer Inspiration, besucht eine Siedlung aus Erdkuppelbauten in der Wüste und wirft schließlich einen Blick in ein Anwesen mit königlichem Flair.

Jack besichtigt eine Kirche, die zu einem Wohnhaus umgebaut wurde. Danach besucht er ein farbenfrohes Haus in der kalifornischen Wüste und entdeckt schließlich ein historisches Gebäude, das eine völlig neue Bestimmung als Zuhause gefunden hat.

Im mittleren Westen tourt Retta durch drei abscheuliche Häuser, die um die Chance auf eine Renovierung wetteifern. Sie erhält einen Einblick in einen Unterwasser-Seepalast, einen Rückfall aus den 1960er-Jahren und ein ehemaliges Bestattungsinstitut.

Retta ist in den Südosten unterwegs, um sich die hässliche Heimkonkurrenz anzusehen. Retta erkundet ein Sardinenbüchsenhaus mit einem Schlangenproblem, ein Anwesen mit einer fragwürdigen Vergangenheit und ein Haus, das wie eine alte Bank aussieht.

Retta begibt sich in den Nordosten, um die abscheulichste Heimat der Region aufzudecken. Sie stellt das Leben infrage und entwirft Entscheidungen in einer ehemaligen Vorschule, einem Haus in Pyramidenform und einem Albtraum mit rosa Teppich.

Retta findet einen dunklen Fleck an der sonnigen Westküste, als sie drei Häuser untersucht, die eher Albträumen als Träumen ähneln. Sie besucht ein Dschungelhaus, ein Haus, das früher eine Scheune war und ein Boot ähnliches Anwesen.

Greg hat kaum Geld und schläft auf dem Sofa eines Freundes - bis er mit einem Rubbellos eine Million Dollar gewinnt. Davon möchte er maximal 200.000 Dollar in sein Traumhaus investieren, das ein großes Grundstück und vier Schlafzimmer haben soll.

Der alleinerziehende Vater Todd investiert spontan 10 Dollar in einen Lottoautomaten. Kurz darauf erfährt er, dass er 700.000 Dollar gewonnen hat. Todd will direkt aus seiner kleinen Mietwohnung in Louisville, Kentucky, in ein Eigenheim ziehen.

Der Junggeselle Scott will in San Francisco, Kalifornien, neu anfangen und seine Wohnsituation verkleinern. In Begleitung seiner Freundin Christina hofft Scott, ein Minihaus zu finden, das mehr als 35 Quadratmeter hat, ein helles Ambiente und ein separates Schlafzimmer. Er sieht sich Häuser mit dazugehörigen Grundstücken an und würde gern in der Stadt bleiben. Doch sogar mit seinem Budget von 500.000 Dollar könnte es schwer werden, auf dem teuersten Immobilienmarkt der USA etwas zu finden.

Melody und Ben aus Frisco, Texas, sind oft monatelang in Afrika. Dort bauen sie mit ihrer gemeinnützigen Organisation Häuser für die Armen. Da ihre vier Kinder schon erwachsen sind, wollen sich Melody und Ben verkleinern, damit sie weniger Arbeit mit dem Haus haben, wenn sie von ihren Reisen zurückkehren. Melody will etwas Traditionelles mit einem großzügigen Wohnbereich für die Besuche der Kinder, aber Ben wünscht sich ein noch kleineres Haus mit einem Hütten-Feeling.

Richard aus Dallas hat sich dazu entschieden, sein Wohnraum zu verkleinern und hat sich deswegen ein Tiny House gekauft. Dadurch erhofft er sich mehr Freiheit, das zu tun, was er liebt, wie zum Beispiel Fahrradfahren oder sein eigenes Bier brauen.

Die Besitzer eines New Yorker Bed and Breakfast wollen ein Tiny House auf sein Grundstück setzen. Dadurch erhoffen sie sich mehr Gäste, da sie in das neue Haus ziehen würden und die Gäste dadurch das gesamte alte Bauernhaus benutzen können.

Heather und Beau suchen nach einem Haus im Topanga Canyon, in dem sie ihren Sohn in Ruhe aufziehen können. Jedoch kommt es schnell zu Auseinandersetzungen, da Heather einen Bohemian-Chic-Stil will, Beau aber eine rustikale Hütte bevorzugt.

Ashley und ihr Ehemann Travis führen ein Globetrotter-Leben. Deshalb konnten sie nie ihre eigene Wohnung aussuchen. Nun ist die Familie mit den drei Kindern auf dem Weg nach Sansibar, Tansania. Doch Ashley und Travis haben verschiedene Prioritäten.

Die hügelige Landschaft von Kinsale in Florida erinnert Kimberley an Irland, wo ihre Familie herkommt. Mit Peter sucht sie das richtige Haus, denn Peter will ein Buch schreiben und braucht dafür einerseits Anregung, aber auch die nötige Ruhe.

John Stamos überrascht seinen besten Freund aus Schulzeiten mit einer umfassenden Umgestaltung der Garage. Gemeinsam mit Jonathan und Drew verwandelt er den Ort, an dem sie ihre Jugend verbracht haben.
Jonathan und Drew gestalten für Laurences Freund ein Refugium im Hinterhof auf Resortniveau.

Die Studienfreundin der Komikerin Ali Wong, Zitadelle, ist eine berufstätige Mutter, die ihr Zuhause und ihr Herz jedem öffnet. Ali erwidert die Liebe, indem sie Zitadelles kargen Keller in das unterhaltsame Herz ihres Zuhauses verwandelt.

Im Süden der USA stehen drei düstere Häuser im Finale: ein Gangster-Versteck, ein historisches Anwesen voller Hexen und Geister sowie ein Haus, das von seltsamen Kreaturen bewohnt wird. Sie alle kämpfen um eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar.

Drei Spukhäuser stellen sich dem Wettbewerb um die große Renovierung: Ein Haus mit tödlicher Einrichtung, ein Keller voller Geister und eine Kirche, die von Gräbern umgeben ist, sorgen für Gänsehaut. Welches Haus wird in ein Traumdomizil verwandelt?

Im Nordosten der USA treten drei furchteinflößende Häuser gegeneinander an, um eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar zu gewinnen. Zur Wahl steht ein Haus mit einem unheimlichen Brunnen in der Küche und ein Gebäude voller gefährlicher Fallen.

Diesmal fällt die Entscheidung: Welches Haus ist das gruseligste Haus in Amerika? Die Moderatorin Retta verkündet das Gewinnerpaar, und Designerin Alison Victoria verwandelt das schaurigste Gebäude in ein stilvolles Zuhause.
Drei der gruseligsten Häuser im Osten der USA treten gegeneinander an und hoffen auf eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar durch Alison Victoria.

Wir werfen einen Blick auf ein Paar aus Miami, das sich den Traum vom Eigenheim erfüllt hat. Nach Jahren in Mietwohnungen haben sie ihr erstes Haus gekauft. Mithilfe von Freunden und Familie wollen sie es in ein Wohlfühlparadies verwandeln.

Eine Mutter, die einen neuen Lebensabschnitt beginnt, möchte mehr Zeit mit ihren Kindern am Strand verbringen. Sie nutzt ihre Fähigkeiten als pensionierte Kunstlehrerin, um bei der Renovierung ihres Ferienhauses in Ocean City, NJ, zu helfen.
