A ghost ship is found on a remote island, home to one of Earth's last uncontacted tribes. New evidence reveals a mysterious military compound in Russia.
A window washer falls nearly 50 stories and rocks and boulders move on their own.

An eerie shape appears over Chicago. A man is fighting for his life after being shot by an unknown object, and a US military fighter jet appears to be being pursued by a UFO over the Bermuda Triangle.
A fleet of potential UFOs are filmed over the South China Sea, they seem to be appearing and disappearing, Plus, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site features carvings of extraterrestrial humanoids.

John Lennon and May Pang claimed to have seen a UFO from their balcony in New York, and a sinister visitor to a remote nuclear missile launch site in Montana, which more than 40 years ago caused nuclear missiles to be disabled for 24 hours.
A UFO is recorded flying straight from the sky into the sea with no loss of speed. Plus, astronaut Neil Armstrong goes in search of an ancient extraterrestrial library in the Ecuadorian jungle.

Several UFOs suddenly appear above Swedish power plants and other places. Some believe that the country will soon be the target of an attack. A soldier claims to have encountered a UFO years ago and receives compensation from the US military.
A man in Missouri films what looks like a metal cube spinning in the sky. Something very similar is seen in LA, Texas and Columbia.
A mysterious opening on the Red Planet caught on camera, a UFO appears to invade an Amazon village, and an unidentified spacecraft disrupts the queen's jubilee celebrations in London in June 2022.
A US navy warship is orbited by UFOs. Meanwhile, a British TV programme is interrupted by a voice claiming to be from the Ashtar Galactic Command, warning that Earth is in danger.

A UFO is caught on camera by a military helicopter on the Mexican border, an English woman is filmed disappearing from her bed at night, and NASA investigates UFOs after years of denial by the US authorities.

Archäologen sind fasziniert von den Pyramiden von Gizeh - dem einzig erhaltenen antiken Weltwunder. Seit über 200 Jahren rätseln sie, wie sie einst von den Ägyptern erbaut wurden. Zudem ist nach wie vor unklar, was sich darunter befindet.

Für das Geheimnis der Nazca-Linien, die vor 2.000 Jahren von alten Völkern gegründet wurden, gibt es bis heute keine wissenschaftliche Erklärung. Es sind monumentale geometrische Figuren, die die Wüste im Süden Perus durchqueren.

In der Formel 1 und im Indy 500 wird ein talentierter Fahrer schwer verletzt. Auf einer gefährlichen Strecke lässt er sein Leben. Die anspruchsvollen Routen Europas und Amerikas haben ihre Tücken und führen zu Motorsportunfällen.

Diese Dokumentation stellt schief gelaufene Expeditionen in den Vordergrund. Dabei auch die Umrundung der Erde von Amelia Earhart oder die Everest-Katastrophe von 1996. Es sind fesselnde Geschichten und tragische Ereignisse.

In der Pampa Patagoniens wird der Bahnverkehr häufig durch umherziehende Schafe unterbrochen. Grund genug für die Wunderländer, ein witziges Gimmick für die größte Modelleisenbahnanlage der Welt zu bauen. Die Idee: ein Zug soll durch eine Schafherde fahren und diese scheinbar zur Seite treiben. Die technische Umsetzung: eine echte Herausforderung. Knifflig ist auch die Arbeit an der Wellenmaschine, dem neuen Multimedia-Highlight der Anlage.

Nach vier Jahren Bauzeit steht die Eröffnung Patagoniens kurz bevor. Doch der Bahnverkehr läuft alles andere als reibungslos. Die Profis des Wunderlandes arbeiten im Akkord, um die weltgrößte Modelleisenbahn auch im neuen Abschnitt zum Laufen zu bringen. Derweil setzen die Modellbauer die letzten Knopfdruckattraktionen in die Anlage ein. Vom rauchenden Gaucho-Grillfest bis zum beweglichen Wal - Endspurt für die Wunderland-Crew.

Beleuchtet werden Themen aus aller Welt und es Menschen und Geschichten hinter den Schlagzeilen aus der ganzen Welt gezeigt. Berichtet wird über beispielsweise über Atomversuche, Flüchtlinge und viele weitere Ereignisse rund um den Globus.

Start-ups gewinnen als wichtiger Impulsgeber für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft zunehmend an Bedeutung. Dieses Magazin widmet sich in jeder Ausgabe jeweils einem Thema, das Janna Linke gemeinsam mit einem Experten von verschiedenen Seiten beleuchtet.

Abschied vom Handschalter! Wie das Selbstschalten sich langsam aus unseren Autos verabschiedet und warum dem Auto-Romantiker dabei das Herz bricht. Außerdem haben wir das interne Duell Dacia Duster gegen Dacia Bigster im Programm.

Zwischen staubigen Werkstätten und Weltklasse-Kunst: Ein Blick hinter die Fassaden der Alserkal Avenue enthüllt, wie ein emiratischer Geschäftsmann eine verfallene Marmorfabrik im Industriegebiet Al Quoz in Dubais führendes Kunstviertel verwandelte.

Schwärme von Riesenthunfischen vor der Insel Ascension dienten als Futter für heranziehende Haie. Auch Sportfischer haben die Thunfische für sich entdeckt. Doch ihr Auftauchen brachte die Natur aus dem Gleichgewicht und hatte dramatische Folgen.

In der aktuellen Covid-19-Pandemie wird deutlich, welche Auswirkungen Krankheiten und Infektionen auf die menschliche Gesundheit haben können. Tiere wie Fledermäuse, Stechmücken, Zecken und Rinder können durch von ihnen übertragene Krankheiten und Infektionen große Schäden anrichten. Malaria, Borreliose, BSE und Maul- und Klauenseuche sind nur einige der tödlichen Infektionen, die diese Kreaturen übertragen können.

Eine 40 Kilometer breite Kreisstruktur in der Sahara wirft Fragen auf. Die Suche nach ihrem Ursprung widerlegt Mythen über Meteoriten und deckt eine Entstehungsgeschichte auf, die auf magmatischer Aufwölbung und Jahrmillionen von Erosion beruht.

Der Blick von oben offenbart einen geheimnisvollen Hügel in Norwegen, einen prähistorischen Steinkreis am Ufer des Flusses Targus, eine uralte verlorene Stadt in der Wiege der Zivilisation und seltsame Steingebilde im Land der Götter und Monster.
Die Sendung zeigt die größten Lkw-Unfälle und Kollisionen, die weltweit gefilmt wurden.

Diese Reise zeigt die erstaunliche Vielfalt der wilden Hunde. Vom arktischen Wolf über den geselligen Dhole bis zum kleinen Fennek und dem langbeinigen Mähnenwolf: Die Reihe entdeckt 37 faszinierende Arten und zeigt ihr Leben.

Der Flughafen in Bogotá gehört zu den wichtigsten Drehkreuzen Lateinamerikas. Jährlich sind dort 23 Millionen Passagiere und mehr als 500.000 Tonnen Transportgüter auf der Durchreise. Die Sicherheitsbeamten haben alle Hände voll zu tun.

In England scheinen Satellitenbildern zufolge seltsame Gebäude zu stehen. Forscher sind neugierig. Als sie vor Ort sind, finden sie die Hinterlassenschaften einer furchtbaren Zeit. Auf Hawaii schockiert ein Fund eines steinigen Parallelogramms.

Spaniens berühmte Costa del Sol erstrahlt plötzlich weiß. Schneit es mitten im Sommer, oder stecken Menschen dahinter? Können Satellitenaufnahmen endlich enthüllen, wie El Chapo, einer der berüchtigtsten Drogenbarone der Welt, aus Mexikos Hochsicherheitsgefängnis entkommen konnte? Außerdem entdecken Bildanalysten unzählige bunte Kreise in der Sahara. Kann es sich dabei um ein bisher unbekanntes Naturphänomen handeln? Die Doku forscht nach.
Eine Frau aus Hongkong wird verdächtigt, da sie zur Besichtigung eines zerstörten Hauses anreist.
In der Dokumentation werden verschiedene Verkehrsmomente von Dashcams präsentiert.
Machen Sie sich gefasst auf tollpatschige Kriminelle und spektakuläre Rettungsaktionen.

Die neuseeländischen Grenzschutzbeamten kontrollieren drei israelische Männer, die große Mengen MDMA mit sich führen. Weiterhin stellt sich heraus, dass die Touristen sich auch anderweitig vergnügen: Sie verbringen ihre Urlaubszeit gerne in Sexklubs.

Der Versuch, Alkohol zu schmuggeln, wird von den Zollbeamten in den Häfen von Auckland vereitelt. Ein kurdischer Neuseeländer erzählt von seinen großen Abenteuern in Risikoländern und eine Französin gerät außer sich und in Rage.

Neuseelands Grenzschützer und Spürhunde überwachen Einreisende, Gepäck, Post und Fracht auf Schmuggelware und Biosicherheitsrisiken. Von Auckland bis Queenstown zeigt die Doku ihre akribische Arbeit zum Schutz der Inselnation.

Die Zollbeamten am internationalen Flughafen von Christchurch verdächtigen das Gepäck eines Kanadiers. Weiterhin bemerken sie ein ungewöhnlich farbenfrohes Päckchen aus Uganda. Schließlich belügt eine Philippinerin die Beamten.
Eine Brasilianerin verhält sich verdächtig. Ein Reisender gibt den Beamten einen hilfreichen Tipp.

Die Beamten fassen einen Chinesen, der mehr Zigaretten als erlaubt transportiert. Weiterhin verdächtigen sie eine Fracht mit Kupferdraht. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dort die Droge Crystal Meth versteckt eingeschmuggelt wird.
Der Grenzschutz sucht Prostituierte aus Hongkong ab. Ein illegaler Waffentransport wird aufgedeckt.
Die Spürhunde lenken die Aufmerksamkeit des Grenzschutzes auf ein Paket aus Brasilien.

Es werden legendäre Filmsets mit überraschender Vergangenheit und echten Schauplätzen gezeigt, die berühmte Hollywood-Filme inspirierten. Diese verfallenen Bauwerke sind alle von einer bemerkenswerten Geschichte geprägt.

In Nordwales liegt eine verlassene, geheime Anlage, in der einst Senfgas und angereichertes Uran hergestellt wurden. Eine luxuriöse Quarantäneeinrichtung auf der Insel Malta, in der Nähe der Hauptstadt Valletta, birgt ein dunkles Geheimnis.

Die Sendung besucht die Ruinen einer früheren Industriestadt in den Vereinigten Staaten und eine schottische Insel im Atlantik. Außerdem führt der Weg zu den Gedenkstätten eines großen Feuers im japanischen Kobe.

Verändert ein 50.000 Jahre altes Bärenknochenfragment mit sorgfältig eingravierten Löchern den Platz der Menschheit in der Evolution? Kann ein schwarzer Schuh ein Hightech-Gerät sein, das entwickelt wurde, um ein Casino zu überlisten?
Ein geheimnisvoller Kristallschädel und eine rätselhafte Tontafel werfen Fragen über Mythen auf.

Der größte Wasserthemenpark seiner Art im Mittleren Osten ist das Aquaventure in Dubai. Er ist jüngst um ein weiteres 5,5 Hektar großes Paradies an Baderutschen sowie einen Parkteil mit einem 34 Meter hohen Rutschenturm erweitert worden.

Der ehemalige Achterbahn-Testpark in Rust zieht täglich bis zu 30.000 Gäste an. Für einen reibungslosen Ablauf und ein unvergessliches Erlebnis sorgt ein engagiertes Team aus Technikern, Reinigungskräften und Gastronomen im Hintergrund.

Mit einem Gelände so groß wie 20 Fußballfelder ist die Therme Erding das größte Thermalbad der Welt. Die Folge wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen des Thermenkomplexes vor den Toren Münchens und zeigt die verborgene Technik.

Das Angebot an Gartengeräten ist riesig. Da fällt es bei all den Modellen nicht leicht, den Überblick zu behalten, um zielsicher das Passende zu finden. Diverse Gartengeräte werden auf Handhabung, Belastbarkeit und Sicherheit getestet.

Was früher mit viel Zeit und Aufwand verbunden war, wird heutzutage massenweise und in kürzester Zeit hergestellt: das moderne Fertighaus. Ebenso wie viele andere Massenprodukte werden sie in Serie gefertigt, Bäume in großen Mengen gefällt, maschinell verarbeitet und als fertige Teile geliefert. Was also damals Jahre dauerte, dauert inzwischen Tage. Wie genau die einzelnen Schritte vom Baum bis zum Haus ablaufen und bewerkstelligt werden, veranschaulichen die beteiligten Fachleute.

Der Edge East Side Tower, der zwischen Kreuzberg und Friedrichshain gebaut wird, soll mit einer Höhe von 142 Metern und 35 Stockwerken das höchste Bürogebäude Berlins werden. Hinter dem Bau steckt viel Arbeit und eine große Investition.

Das noch recht junge "Squaire" gilt als Deutschlands größtes Bürogebäude. Dabei beherbergt es als multifunktionales Bauwerk nicht nur Büroräumlichkeiten, sondern auch Hotels, Geschäfte, Restaurants, Parkplätze und sogar einen Bahnhof. Die Nähe zum Flughafen ist natürlich in jeder Hinsicht von Vorteil - sowohl für den Personenverkehr der Reisenden und Mitarbeiter als auch für den Warentransport in die untergebrachten Handelsunternehmen.

Bei einem Großeinsatz auf der Juarez-Lincoln Bridge werden zwei Frauen vorläufig festgenommen. Die Beamten überprüfen ihre Fracht auf illegale Schmugglerware. Auch der Lieferwagen eines älteren Mannes wird gründlich untersucht.

In the Southern Atlantic and Indian Oceans, between the latitudes of 40 and 60 degrees south, there is a scattering of tiny, inhospitable islands that are crucial to the survival of millions of marine creatures that use these islands to breed. South Georgia, Bouvet, Marion and Crozet Islands are home to some of the world's largest populations of elephant seals, Antarctic fur seals, wandering albatross and king and macaroni penguins. These creatures, superbly adapted to life in a freezing ocean.

The islands found in the Southern Indian and Pacific Oceans are so remote that man hardly ever sets foot on them. They're some of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but they are crucial to the survival of some of the world's rarest creatures. Southern right whales breed in the bay of Auckland and Enderby, New Zealand sea lions and yellow-eyed penguins use the beaches and forests. Royal penguins nest only on the island of Macquarie and the royal albatross uses the slopes of Campbell Island.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
During Pie Swap Day in Adventure Bay, Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr Porter's delicious pies so he can join the contest.
When Ms. Marjorie brings her bookmobile to Everest and the kids of the mountains, Maynard accidentally sets the van rolling and goes off on a wild ride.
A superfood cake creates some superheroes. Paddington wants to become a Knight.
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes, Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome.
It's time for the annual fun run in Windsor Gardens Park, however Paddington is not very fit. Jonathan, Judy, and Paddington accidentally break Mrs. Bird's much-loved rocking chair.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia take on their parents at Tailball.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Ben and Holly set out in the elves' new vessel to try and rescue Redbeard the elf pirate's sunken treasure. However, hungry Big Bad Barry is determined to stop them.
King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, worst fish ever, Big Bad Barry.
The bats that nest in Grandad's shed each year are missing. Can Stan and Gran encourage these nocturnal creatures to return when they can't hear them?
Stan and Gran are enjoying a beach clean, but the rubbish seems to have a mind of its own! When a yoghurt pot goes walk-about, Stan spies a mystery!

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
While Jade parties, Baron Bite raids the Crystal Caves and causes crystal carnage. Rammy learns an ancient Kung Fu move that transforms him into a giant stone pangolin.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.

Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip. The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.

Baron Bite takes Sir Steel's submarine and modifies it into the Sub-Zero Sub, granting himself unrestricted movement. The team use their planet powers which animates Trick Alien's enormous balloon animals.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia eagerly agree to bird-sit the Bronte family's exotic Moon Parrot.
Animated, Children, Science fiction, Adventure, Comedy
Tim does everything he can to get the new DinoStar toy.
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.
A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House; however, to meet their new neighbour, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.
Gabby finds a book with the same doodle on every page; inside the dollhouse, the Gabby Cats use their imagination to add their own spin to the drawings.

Farmer's snails are tired of their life of toil and decide to go on strike and join Wild for a life of freedom; the Smurfs prepare their sarsaparilla banquet, unaware that Gargamel has enchanted the thicket.
When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea. Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show, but Rosie disappears.
Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.
The PAW Patrol is on an excavation dig when they unearth three fossilised eggs. Suddenly the eggs start to hatch and there are three baby pterodactyls running around.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.
It is harvest day. The elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all.
The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.

When Mayor Humdinger's trash-compacting truck messes up the beach, Rocky's new Re-Use It Truck comes to the rescue; when a gift of armour for the Princess gets scattered all over town, Rocky uses his Re-Use It Truck to put the armour back together.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares stories that are fully dressed.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
Nanny Plum conjures up a hamster called Pippin for the twins.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
The engines are excited to see the Northern Lights with Harold the Helicopter.
Bruno and Thomas must step outside their comfort zones to find Bruno's prized map, which gets swept away by the wind.

Dora and Boots transform into mermaids for an all-new underwater mission of the Mermaid Kingdom. Mermaid Dora and her companion, Boots the mer-monkey, help a lost pink dolphin find a magic jewel it needs.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a big farm, to find cows. The children travel to Lucy Big's farm, where she shows them all the animals.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.
Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's Award for Industry for all the hard work she does, and Peppa and her friends will accompany her to the palace to meet the Queen.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good and was once a world champion, but in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.

Thaddäus ernennt SpongeBob aus Faulheit zum Chef vom Dienst, was allerdings nur 15 Minuten währt, da dann bereits das Chaos ausgebrochen ist. Und: Sandy, Mr. Krabs und Patrick bitten SpongeBob um Gefallen, die er ihnen nicht abschlagen möchte.

Mr. Krabs stellt Patrick in der Krossen Krabbe ein, um die Kunden zu belustigen. Er spielt den umfallenden Idioten. SpongeBob und Patrick finden einen Spielzeugladen so toll, dass sie sich über Nacht dort einschließen lassen.

Was als Freundschaftsausflug auf den Strand beginnt, endet für SpongeBob und Patrick in einem heftigen Wettbewerb im Bauen von Sandburgen. SpongeBob zerbricht Garys Schneckenhaus und versucht für Ersatz zu sorgen, doch er ist zu tollpatschig.

Planktons Frau Karen rät ihm, dass er mehr Werbung für den "Abfalleimer" machen soll. Aber den Durchbruch erlebt Plankton erst mit einem Werbeslogan, der ausgerechnet von Patrick stammt. Und: Plankton vergisst seinen Hochzeitstag mit Karen.

Mr. Krabs will mehr Geld in die Kasse spülen und feiert deshalb den Geburtstag der Krossen Krabbe, bei der viele Pasteten verkauft werden sollen. Allerdings sperren sich Thaddäus, Patrick, SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs versehentlich in der Kühltruhe ein.

Auf der Geburtstagsfeier von Krosse Krabbe schließen sich SpongeBob und seine Freunde aus Versehen in einer Kühltruhe ein und versuchen nun, wieder freizukommen. Derweil macht sich Plankton auf, um das Pasteten-Rezept zu finden.

Thaddäus ist wegen eines Sturms mit SpongeBob und Patrick im Haus eingeschlossen. Plankton entdeckt per Zufall eine Unterwasser-Höhle. Er macht daraus ein Ausflugsziel und hört die Kassen klingeln, was Mr. Krabs nicht auf sich sitzen lassen kann.

König Neptuns 5000. Geburtstag steht an und seine Frau plant in der Krossen Krabbe eine Party für ihn. Doch als alle nett beisammen sind, taucht der verbannte Sohn der beiden, Triton, auf. SpongeBob will die drei wieder vereinen.

Thaddäus Lieblingssendung wurde abgesetzt, und er beschließt, selbst eine Sendung zu drehen und SpongeBob wird beim Tanzen zufällig von einer Agentin entdeckt. Thaddäus ist neidisch auf SpongeBobs Erfolg und versucht, dessen Casting zu sabotieren.

Thaddäus und Blubber-Bass müssen sich auf einer Reise nach Muschelhausen gegenseitig ertragen. Thaddäus macht eine Reise in die Fantasiebox und muss sich auf die Kreativität von SpongeBob und Patrick verlassen, um zu entkommen.

Plankton entdeckt das geheime Ersatzrezept für den Krabbenburger im Eimer. Er versucht den Eimer zu stehlen. Zudem entwickelt SpongeBob nach einem Unfall einen unkontrollierbaren Lachanfall, was alle im Krossen Krabben zur Verzweiflung treibt.

SpongeBobs Quallenfischernetz ist verschwunden, und er verdächtigt Patrick des Diebstahls. Weil der echte Thaddäus nicht mit SpongeBob spielen will, bastelt er sich einfach selbst einen kleinen Thaddäus und spielt mit der Handpuppe.

SpongeBob hat beschlossen, ab jetzt nur noch unter Quallen fernab der Zivilisation zu leben. Seine Freunde versuchen, ihn zur Umkehr zu bewegen, aber der kleine Schwamm bleibt bei seiner Entscheidung. Doch dann zeigen die Quallen ihr wahres Gesicht.

SpongeBob freut sich auf einen Tag mit Burger braten und Quallenfischen, aber alles geht schief. Ein Missgeschick nach dem nächsten passiert. Patrick macht SpongeBob ein ganz besonderes Geschenk: sein Gummiteil - ein Ball aus Kaugummi.

Mr. Krabs und Plankton waren als Jugendliche unzertrennlich, haben sich dann aber um ein Bulettenrezept zerstritten. Allerdings erzählen sie beide ziemlich unterschiedliche Versionen von diesem Streit. Welche Geschichte stimmt?

SpongeBob lernt Jim kennen, den allerersten Burgerbrater der Krossen Krabbe, der sehr beliebt war. Außerdem schmecken seine Burger noch besser als die von SpongeBob. SpongeBob hat Angst vor der Dunkelheit und macht die Nacht zum Tage.

SpongeBob will herausfinden, was sein Freund morgens macht. SpongeBob hat viel Müsli gegessen, um die Deckel zu sammeln und ein Spielzeug umsonst zu bekommen. Außerdem hat er einen Hautausschlag, der ganz schlimm juckt. Er ist ansteckend.

SpongeBob und Patrick sollen für Mr. Krabs dessen Erzfeind Plankton ausspionieren. Thaddäus und SpongeBob sollen in einem Film zeigen, wie die Wasserverkehr-Regeln funktionieren. Mr. Krabs hat eine neue Idee, um mehr Kunden zu bekommen.

Patrick und SpongeBob legen ein Tunnelsystem unter Bikini Bottom an, weil sie nicht mehr auf das Grundstück von Thaddäus dürfen. Patrick entpuppt sich dabei als enormes Karatetalent, doch leider kann er sein neues Können nicht im Zaum halten.

Blaze und sein Freund AJ fahren bei einem Monstertruckwettrennen mit und werden von einem Konkurrenten ausgetrickst. Der gemeine Crusher will unbedingt gewinnen und benutzt einen Seifenblasenstab, um die anderen wegfliegen zu lassen.
Der junge SpongeBob möchte seine erste Qualle fangen und erhält dabei Hilfe von seinen Freunden.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.
Thaddäus verbringt einen Tag im Waschsalon. SpongeBob und Patrick suchen ein Wurmschwein.

Der Tierpflegesalon wird überraschend inspiziert. Das kaputte Rohr, um das sich Jack und Lily nicht gekümmert haben, könnte alles ruinieren. Chuck hat ein neues Unterfangen: ein Theatercamp. Jack und Lily wittern Betrug, doch es steckt mehr dahinter.

Jack und Lily erhalten von Will und Min Hausarrest, doch die Situation ändert sich, als die beiden Aufpasser selbst von Halmoni bestraft werden. Währenddessen leidet Jack beim Filmfestival in Canyon Valley unter großer Anspannung.

Schere, Stein und Papier wollen beweisen, dass sie besser sind als ein weiteres gleichnamiges Trio. Stein und Papiere versuchen gemeinsam, einen Streit zwischen Schere und einer Magierin zu schlichten, bevor die Magie ihr Leben zerstört.

Papier befürchtet, dass Bleistift zu viel Angst haben wird, wenn sie einen Horrorfilm anschauen. Stein und Schere müssen Papier schnell helfen, denn ein leichter Wind weht und Papier ist noch auf der Straße. Die beiden müssen ihn retten.

Lincoln muss seine zehn Schwestern vom Fernseher fernhalten, damit er seine Lieblingssendung gucken kann. Lincoln hinterlässt für Lori eine böse Nachricht, was ihm sofort leid tut, als es bereits passiert ist. Er will die Nachricht unbemerkt löschen.

Lincoln wird in der Schule von einem Rowdy gehänselt, was ihm sehr peinlich ist. Er will diesen Umstand vor seinen Schwestern verheimlichen. Lincoln will endlich eine Trophäe gewinnen. In seinem Eifer übertreibt er sein Vorhaben etwas.

Lincoln versucht, Leni das Autofahren beizubringen. Allerdings stellt sich das als schwieriger als zunächst angenommen heraus. Lincoln passt es nicht, dass Lori als Babysitterin so streng ist. Er will das Kommando übernehmen - mit Überraschungen.

Lincoln möchte beim Familienausflug den besten Platz im Auto ergattern. Das sehen seine Schwestern allerdings anders. Lincoln will nicht mehr am Kindertisch sitzen. Er will seine Reife beweisen, um am Erwachsenentisch sitzen zu dürfen.
Lincoln hört ein Gespräch seiner Eltern und befürchtet, dass diese ihn loswerden wollen.

SpongeBob wird von einer Agentin zu einem Vortanzen eingeladen, weil er viel Talent hat. Thaddäus ist eifersüchtig, denn er ist auch ehrgeizig, was das Tanzen betrifft. Er trainiert hart, um den begnadeten SpongeBob zu übertrumpfen.
SpongeBob will Künstler werden und belegt einen Kunstkurs, der von Thaddäus unterrichtet wird.

1. Geschichte: Plankton erschafft einen Klon aus sich und Mr. Krabs. Doch dann kommt ein neuer Restaurantbesitzer. 2. Geschichte: Thaddäus tauscht seinen Job mit einem Busfahrer. Die Arbeit ist entspannt, bis SpongeBob und Patrick einsteigen.

Thaddäus nimmt am Tanzwettbewerb teil und möchte diesen unter allen Umständen gewinnen. Er kann sich schon mit dem Siegerpokal sehen. Doch die Jury ist unbarmherzig und er leidet unter schlimmen Krämpfen, die er nicht loswird.

Die Kunden der Krossen Krabbe wandern ab zur Konkurrenz. Dort fungiert eine Statue des Eigentümers als Kletterfels für Kinder. Mr. Krabs möchte sich daraufhin auch in Stein meißeln lassen und engagiert dafür Thaddäus. Doch sie teilen keine Vision.

1. Geschichte: Als SpongeBob freiwillig auf die drei Nichten von Sandy aufpasst, wächst ihm die ganze Sache über den Kopf. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob und Patrick arbeiten als Museumswächter. Doch dann versucht Thaddäus unbemerkt sein Gemälde dort aufzuhängen.

Die Kids' Choice Awards 2026 wecken das Kind in jedem von uns. "VMA"-Gewinner Alex Warren moderiert die "Slime-Party" des Jahres, auf der wir eure Lieblingsstars aus Film, Fernsehen, Musik, Sport und Social Media feiern.

Der frühere Freund Shoot, eine Bambussprosse, kehrt zurück. Doch die drei Freunde wollen nicht mehr mit ihm befreundet sein. Stein hat seinen ersten Arbeitstag bei Franz Roll. Der zeigt sich sehr exzentrisch und äußerst anspruchsvoll.

Papier glaubt, er sei an einer Elite-Uni angenommen worden. Dann merkt er, dass er nur in der dritten Klasse gelandet ist, die jedoch überraschend schwer ist. Schere bringt Lou dazu zu kündigen. Daraufhin übernimmt Catalina und ruiniert sein Leben.
Cecil zeigt seine Sammlung von Schnurrbärten und die Familie Star bringt eine Alraunwurzel heim.

Pinky glaubt, dass seine Mitschüler Babs, JJ und ihn als Clique wahrnehmen, und lädt sie fortan zu allem ein. Pinky ist begeistert, wie nett die Leute sind, wenn sie denken, dass er verletzt ist. Er beschließt, die Lüge aufrechtzuerhalten.

Weil sein Bruder Lance über dem Restaurant ein Fitnessstudio aufbauen will, wird es für Dad schwierig, die Tafel von Lynn zu managen. Lola wird über alle Geschehnisse in der Schule informiert und soll daher eine Klatschkolumne starten.

Verkleidet als die intergalaktische Crew aus ihrem Lieblingsfilm machen sich Lincoln und seine Freunde auf den Weg zum Sammeln von Süßigkeiten. Doch der Abend nimmt eine unheimliche Wendung, als Menschen plötzlich verschwinden.
